sections.label: A hymn of prayer and praise to Prithivi or deified Earth
sections.name: Book 12, hymn 1

verses.sa:
सत्यं बृहदृतमुग्रं दीक्षा तपो ब्रह्म यज्ञः पृथिवीं धारयन्ति ।
सा नो भूतस्य भव्यस्य पत्न्युरुं लोकं पृथिवी नः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: satyaṃ bṛhadṛtamugraṃ dīkṣā tapo brahma yajñaḥ pṛthivīṃ dhārayanti sā no bhūtasya bhavyasya patnyuruṃ lokaṃ pṛthivī naḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Truth high and potent Law, the Consecrating Rite, Fervour, Brahma, and Sacrifice uphold the Earth, May she, the Queen of all that is and is to be, may Prithivi make ample space and room for us,

verses.sa:
असंबाधं बध्यतो मानवानां यस्या उद्वतः प्रवतः समं बहु।
नानावीर्या ओषधीर्या बिभर्ति पृथिवी नः प्रथतां राध्यतां नः॥
verses.tr: asaṃbādhaṃ badhyato mānavānāṃ yasyā udvataḥ pravataḥ samaṃ bahu nānāvīryā oṣadhīryā bibharti pṛthivī naḥ prathatāṃ rādhyatāṃ naḥ
verses.en: Not over-crowded by the crowd of Manu's sons, she who hath many heights and floods and level plains; She who bears plants endowed with many varied powers, may Prithivi for us spread wide and favour us,

verses.sa:
यस्यां समुद्र उत सिन्धुरापो यस्यामन्नं कृष्टयः संबभूवुः ।
यस्यामिदं जिन्वति प्राणदेजत् सा नो भूमिः पूर्वपेये दधातु॥
verses.tr: yasyāṃ samudra uta sindhurāpo yasyāmannaṃ kṛṣṭayaḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ yasyāmidaṃ jinvati prāṇadejat sā no bhūmiḥ pūrvapeye dadhātu
verses.en: In whom the sea, and Sindhu, and the waters, in whom our food and corn-lands had their being, In whom this all that breathes and moves is active, this Earth assign us foremost rank and station!

verses.sa:
यस्याश्चतस्रः प्रदिशः पृथिव्या यस्यामन्नं कृष्टयः संबभूवुः ।
या बिभर्ति बहुधा प्राणदेजत् सा नो भूमिर्गोष्वप्यन्ने दधातु॥
verses.tr: yasyāścatasraḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthivyā yasyāmannaṃ kṛṣṭayaḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ yā bibharti bahudhā prāṇadejat sā no bhūmirgoṣvapyanne dadhātu
verses.en: She who is Lady of the earth's four regions, in whom our food and corn-lands had their being, Nurse in each place of breathing, moving creatures, this Earth vouchsafe us kine with milk that fails

verses.sa:
यस्यां पूर्वे पूर्वजना विचक्रिरे यस्यां देवा असुरानभ्यवर्तयन्।
गवामश्वानां वयसश्च विष्ठा भगं वर्चः पृथिवी नो दधातु॥
verses.tr: yasyāṃ pūrve pūrvajanā vicakrire yasyāṃ devā asurānabhyavartayan gavāmaśvānāṃ vayasaśca viṣṭhā bhagaṃ varcaḥ pṛthivī no dadhātu
verses.en: On whom the men of old before us battled, on whom the Gods attacked the hostile demons, The varied home of bird, and kine anh horses, this Prithivi vouchsafe us luck and splendour! none Rh

verses.sa:
विश्वंभरा वसुधानी प्रतिष्ठा हिरण्यवक्षा जगतो निवेशनी ।
वैश्वानरं बिभ्रती भूमिरग्निमिन्द्रऋषभा द्रविणे नो दधातु॥
verses.tr: viśvaṃbharā vasudhānī pratiṣṭhā hiraṇyavakṣā jagato niveśanī vaiśvānaraṃ bibhratī bhūmiragnimindraṛṣabhā draviṇe no dadhātu
verses.en: Firm standing-place, all-bearing, store of treasures, gold-breasted, harbourer of all that moveth, May Earth who bears Agni Vaisvanara, Consort of mighty Indra, give us great possessions.

verses.sa:
यां रक्षन्त्यस्वप्ना विश्वदानीं देवा भूमिं पृथिवीमप्रमादम्।
सा नो मधु प्रियं दुहामथो उक्षतु वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: yāṃ rakṣantyasvapnā viśvadānīṃ devā bhūmiṃ pṛthivīmapramādam sā no madhu priyaṃ duhāmatho ukṣatu varcasā
verses.en: May Earth, may Prithivi, always protected with ceaseless care by Gods who never slumber, May she pour out for us delicious nectar, may she bedew us with a flood of splendour.

verses.sa:
यार्णवेऽधि सलिलमग्र आसीद् यां मायाभिरन्वचरन् मनीषिणः ।
यस्या हृदयं परमे व्योऽमन्त्सत्येनावृतममतं पृथिव्याः।
सा नो भूमिस्त्विषिं बलं राष्ट्रे दधातूत्तमे॥
verses.tr: yārṇave'dhi salilamagra āsīd yāṃ māyābhiranvacaran manīṣiṇaḥ yasyā hṛdayaṃ parame vyo'mantsatyenāvṛtamamataṃ pṛthivyāḥ sā no bhūmistviṣiṃ balaṃ rāṣṭre dadhātūttame
verses.en: She who at first was water in the ocean, whom with their wondrous powers the sages followed, May she whose heart is in the highest heaven, compassed about with truth, and everlasting, May she, this Earth, bestow upon us lustre, and grant us power in loftiest dominion.

verses.sa:
यस्यामापः परिचराः समानीरहोरात्रे अप्रमादं क्षरन्ति ।
सा नो भूमिर्भूरिधारा पयो दुहामथो उक्षतु वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: yasyāmāpaḥ paricarāḥ samānīrahorātre apramādaṃ kṣaranti sā no bhūmirbhūridhārā payo duhāmatho ukṣatu varcasā
verses.en: On whom the running universal waters flow day and night with never-ceasing motion, May she with many streams pour milk to feed us, may she bedew us with a flood of splendour,

verses.sa:
यामश्विनावमिमातां विष्णुर्यस्यां विचक्रमे।
इन्द्रो यां चक्र आत्मनेऽनमित्रां शचीपतिः ।
सा नो भूमिर्वि सृजतां माता पुत्राय मे पयः॥
verses.tr: yāmaśvināvamimātāṃ viṣṇuryasyāṃ vicakrame indro yāṃ cakra ātmane'namitrāṃ śacīpatiḥ sā no bhūmirvi sṛjatāṃ mātā putrāya me payaḥ
verses.en: She whom the Asvins measured out, o'er whom the foot of Vishnu strode, Whom Indra, Lord of Power and Might, freed from all foemen for himself, May Earth pour out her milk for us, a mother unto me her son.

verses.sa:
गिरयस्ते पर्वता हिमवन्तोऽरण्यं ते पृथिवि स्योनमस्तु ।
बभ्रुं कृष्णां रोहिणीं विश्वरूपां ध्रुवां भूमिं पृथिवीमिन्द्रगुप्ताम्।
अजीतोऽहतो अक्षतोऽध्यष्ठां पृथिवीमहम्॥
verses.tr: girayaste parvatā himavanto'raṇyaṃ te pṛthivi syonamastu babhruṃ kṛṣṇāṃ rohiṇīṃ viśvarūpāṃ dhruvāṃ bhūmiṃ pṛthivīmindraguptām ajīto'hato akṣato'dhyaṣṭhāṃ pṛthivīmaham
verses.en: O Prithivi, auspicious be thy woodlands, auspicious be thy hills and snow-clad mountains, Unslain, un wounded, unsubdued, I have set foot upon the Earth, On earth, brown, black, ruddy and every-coloured, on the firm earth that Indra guards from danger.

verses.sa:
यत् ते मध्यं पृथिवि यच्च नभ्यं यास्त ऊर्जस्तन्वः संबभूवुः ।
ता सु नो धेह्यभि नः पवस्व माता भूमिः पुत्रो अहं पृथिव्याः।
पर्जन्यः पिता स उ नः पिपर्तु॥
verses.tr: yat te madhyaṃ pṛthivi yacca nabhyaṃ yāsta ūrjastanvaḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ tā su no dhehyabhi naḥ pavasva mātā bhūmiḥ putro ahaṃ pṛthivyāḥ parjanyaḥ pitā sa u naḥ pipartu
verses.en: O Prithivi, thy centre and thy navel, all forces that have issued from thy body—. Set us amid those forces; breathe upon us, I am the son of Earth, Earth is my Mother. Parjanya is my Sire; may he promote me.

verses.sa:
यस्यां वेदिं परिगृह्णन्ति भूम्यां यस्यां यज्ञं तन्वते विश्वकर्माणः ।
यस्यां मीयन्ते स्वरवः पृथिव्यामूर्ध्वाः शुक्रा आहुत्याः पुरस्तात्।
सा नो भूमिर्वर्धयद् वर्धमाना॥
verses.tr: yasyāṃ vediṃ parigṛhṇanti bhūmyāṃ yasyāṃ yajñaṃ tanvate viśvakarmāṇaḥ yasyāṃ mīyante svaravaḥ pṛthivyāmūrdhvāḥ śukrā āhutyāḥ purastāt sā no bhūmirvardhayad vardhamānā
verses.en: Earth on whose surface they enclose the altar, and all-performers spin the thread of worship; In whom the stakes of sacrifice, resplendent, are fixed and raised on high before the oblation, may she, this Earth, prospering, make us prosper.

verses.sa:
यो नो द्वेषत् पृथिवि यः पृतन्याद् योऽभिदासान्मनसा यो वधेन ।
तं नो भूमे रन्धय पूर्वकृत्वरि॥
verses.tr: yo no dveṣat pṛthivi yaḥ pṛtanyād yo'bhidāsānmanasā yo vadhena taṃ no bhūme randhaya pūrvakṛtvari
verses.en: The man who hates us, Earth! who fights against us, who threaten us with thought or deadly weapon, make him our thrall as thou hast done aforetime.

verses.sa:
त्वज्जातास्त्वयि चरन्ति मर्त्यास्त्वं बिभर्षि द्विपदस्त्वं चतुष्पदः ।
तवेमे पृथिवि पञ्च मानवा येभ्यो ज्योतिरमृतं मर्त्येभ्य उद्यन्त्सूर्यो रश्मिभिरातनोति॥
verses.tr: tvajjātāstvayi caranti martyāstvaṃ bibharṣi dvipadastvaṃ catuṣpadaḥ taveme pṛthivi pañca mānavā yebhyo jyotiramṛtaṃ martyebhya udyantsūryo raśmibhirātanoti
verses.en: Produced from thee, on thee move mortal creatures: thou bearest them, both quadruped and biped. Thine, Prithivi, are these Five human Races, for whom, though mortal, Surya as he rises spreads with his rays the light that is immortal,

verses.sa: ता नः प्रजाः सं दुह्रतां समग्रा वाचो मधु पृथिवि धेहि मह्यम्॥
verses.tr: tā naḥ prajāḥ saṃ duhratāṃ samagrā vāco madhu pṛthivi dhehi mahyam
verses.en: In concert may these creatures yield us blessings. With honey of discourse, O Ertb, endow me.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्वं मातरमोषधीनां ध्रुवां भूमिं पृथिवीं धर्मणा धृताम्।
शिवां स्योनामनु चरेम विश्वहा॥
verses.tr: viśvasvaṃ mātaramoṣadhīnāṃ dhruvāṃ bhūmiṃ pṛthivīṃ dharmaṇā dhṛtām śivāṃ syonāmanu carema viśvahā
verses.en: Kind, ever gracious be the Earth we tread on, the firm Earth, Prithivi, borne up by Order, mother of plants and herbs, the all-producer,

verses.sa:
महत् सधस्थं महती बभूविथ महान् वेग एजथुर्वेपथुष्टे ।
महांस्त्वेन्द्रो रक्षत्यप्रमादम्।
सा नो भूमे प्र रोचय हिरण्यस्येव संदृशि मा नो द्विक्षत कश्चन॥
verses.tr: mahat sadhasthaṃ mahatī babhūvitha mahān vega ejathurvepathuṣṭe mahāṃstvendro rakṣatyapramādam sā no bhūme pra rocaya hiraṇyasyeva saṃdṛśi mā no dvikṣata kaścana
verses.en: A vast abode hast thou become, the Mighty, Great stress is on thee, press and agitation, but with unceasing care great Indra guards thee, So make us shine, O Earth, us with the splendour of gold. Let no man look on us with hatred.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्भूम्यामोषधीष्वग्निमापो बिभ्रत्यग्निरश्मसु ।
अग्निरन्तः पुरुषेषु गोष्वश्वेष्वग्नयः॥
verses.tr: agnirbhūmyāmoṣadhīṣvagnimāpo bibhratyagniraśmasu agnirantaḥ puruṣeṣu goṣvaśveṣvagnayaḥ
verses.en: Agni is in the earth, in plants; the waters hold Agni in them, in the stones is Agni, Agni abideth deep in men: Agnis abide in cows and steeds.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्दिव आ तपत्यग्नेर्देवस्योर्व१न्तरिक्षम्।
अग्निं मर्तास इन्धते हव्यवाहं घृतप्रियम्॥
verses.tr: agnirdiva ā tapatyagnerdevasyorva1ntarikṣam agniṃ martāsa indhate havyavāhaṃ ghṛtapriyam
verses.en: Agni gives shine and heat in heaven: the spacious air is his, the God's, Lover of fatness, bearer of oblation, men enkindle him.

verses.sa: अग्निवासाः पृथिव्यऽसितज्ञूस्त्विषीमन्तं संशितं मा कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: agnivāsāḥ pṛthivya'sitajñūstviṣīmantaṃ saṃśitaṃ mā kṛṇotu
verses.en: Dark-koeed, invested with a fiery mantle, Prithivi sharpen me and give me splendour!

verses.sa:
भूम्यां देवेभ्यो ददति यज्ञं हव्यमरंकृतम्।
भूम्यां मनुष्याऽ जीवन्ति स्वधयान्नेन मर्त्याः ।
सा नो भूमिः प्राणमायुर्दधातु जरदष्टिं मा पृथिवी कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: bhūmyāṃ devebhyo dadati yajñaṃ havyamaraṃkṛtam bhūmyāṃ manuṣyā' jīvanti svadhayānnena martyāḥ sā no bhūmiḥ prāṇamāyurdadhātu jaradaṣṭiṃ mā pṛthivī kṛṇotu
verses.en: On earth they offer sacrifice and dressed oblation to the Gods. Men, mortals, live upon the earth by food in their accustomed way. May that Earth grant us breath and vital, power, Prithivi give me life of long duration!

verses.sa:
यस्ते गन्धः पृथिवि संबभूव यं बिभ्रत्योषधयो यमापः ।
यं गन्धर्वा अप्सरसश्च भेजिरे तेन मा सुरभिं कृणु मा नो द्विक्षत कश्चन॥
verses.tr: yaste gandhaḥ pṛthivi saṃbabhūva yaṃ bibhratyoṣadhayo yamāpaḥ yaṃ gandharvā apsarasaśca bhejire tena mā surabhiṃ kṛṇu mā no dvikṣata kaścana
verses.en: Scent that hath risen from thee, O Earth, the fragrance which growing herbs and plants and waters carry, Shared by Apsarases, shared by Gandharvas. therewith make thou me sweet: let no man hate me.

verses.sa:
यस्ते गन्धः पुष्करमाविवेश यं संजभ्रुः सूर्याया विवाहे।
अमर्त्याः पृथिवि गन्धमग्रे तेन मा सुरभिं कृणु मा नो द्विक्षत कश्चन॥
verses.tr: yaste gandhaḥ puṣkaramāviveśa yaṃ saṃjabhruḥ sūryāyā vivāhe amartyāḥ pṛthivi gandhamagre tena mā surabhiṃ kṛṇu mā no dvikṣata kaścana
verses.en: Thy scent which entered and possessed the lotus, the scent which they prepared at Surya's bridal, Scent which Immortals, Earth! of old collected, therewith make thou me sweet: let no man hate me.

verses.sa:
यस्ते गन्धः पुरुषेषु स्त्रीषु पुंसु भगो रुचिः ।
यो अश्वेषु वीरेषु यो मृगेषूत हस्तिषु ।
कन्याऽयां वर्चो यद् भूमे तेनास्मां अपि सं सृज मा नो द्विक्षत कश्चन॥
verses.tr: yaste gandhaḥ puruṣeṣu strīṣu puṃsu bhago ruciḥ yo aśveṣu vīreṣu yo mṛgeṣūta hastiṣu kanyā'yāṃ varco yad bhūme tenāsmāṃ api saṃ sṛja mā no dvikṣata kaścana
verses.en: Thy scent in women and in men, the luck and light. that is in males, That is in heroes and in steeds in sylvan beasts and elephants, The splendid energy of maids, therewith do thou unite us, Earth! Let no man look on us with hate.

verses.sa:
शिला भूमिरश्मा पांसुः सा भूमिः संधृता धृता।
तस्यै हिरण्यवक्षसे पृथिव्या अकरं नमः॥
verses.tr: śilā bhūmiraśmā pāṃsuḥ sā bhūmiḥ saṃdhṛtā dhṛtā tasyai hiraṇyavakṣase pṛthivyā akaraṃ namaḥ
verses.en: Rock, earth, and stone, and dust, this Earth is held together, firmly bound. To this gold-breasted Prithivi mine adoration have I paid.

verses.sa:
यस्यां वृक्षा वानस्पत्या ध्रुवास्तिष्ठन्ति विश्वहा ।
पृथिवीं विश्वधायसं धृतामच्छावदामसि॥
verses.tr: yasyāṃ vṛkṣā vānaspatyā dhruvāstiṣṭhanti viśvahā pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ dhṛtāmacchāvadāmasi
verses.en: Hither we call the firmly held, the all-supporting Prithivi, On whom the trees, lords of the wood, stand evermore immovable,

verses.sa:
उदीराणा उतासीनास्तिष्ठन्तः प्रक्रामन्तः ।
पद्भ्यां दक्षिणसव्याभ्यां मा व्यथिष्महि भूम्याम्॥
verses.tr: udīrāṇā utāsīnāstiṣṭhantaḥ prakrāmantaḥ padbhyāṃ dakṣiṇasavyābhyāṃ mā vyathiṣmahi bhūmyām
verses.en: Sitting at ease or rising up, standing or going on our way, With our right foot and with our left we will not reel upon the earth.

verses.sa:
विमृग्वरीं पृथिवीमा वदामि क्षमां भूमिं ब्रह्मणा वावृधानाम्।
ऊर्जं पुष्टं बिभ्रतीमन्नभागं घृतं त्वाभि नि षीदेम भूमे॥
verses.tr: vimṛgvarīṃ pṛthivīmā vadāmi kṣamāṃ bhūmiṃ brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānām ūrjaṃ puṣṭaṃ bibhratīmannabhāgaṃ ghṛtaṃ tvābhi ni ṣīdema bhūme
verses.en: I speak to Prithivi the purifier, to patient Earth who groweth strong through Brahma. O Earth, may we recline on thee who bearest strength; J increase, portioned share of food, and fatness,

verses.sa:
शुद्धा न आपस्तन्वेऽ क्षरन्तु यो नः सेदुरप्रिये तं नि दध्मः ।
पवित्रेण पृथिवि मोत् पुनामि॥
verses.tr: śuddhā na āpastanve' kṣarantu yo naḥ sedurapriye taṃ ni dadhmaḥ pavitreṇa pṛthivi mot punāmi
verses.en: Purified for our bodies flow the waters: we bring distress on him who would attack us, I cleanse myself, O Earth, with that which cleanseth,

verses.sa:
यास्ते प्राचीः प्रदिशो या उदीचीर्यास्ते भूमे अधराद् याश्च पश्चात्।
स्योनास्ता मह्यं चरते भवन्तु मा नि पप्तं भुवने शिश्रियाणः॥
verses.tr: yāste prācīḥ pradiśo yā udīcīryāste bhūme adharād yāśca paścāt syonāstā mahyaṃ carate bhavantu mā ni paptaṃ bhuvane śiśriyāṇaḥ
verses.en: Earth, be thine eastern and thy northern regions, those lying south ward and those lying westward, Propitious unto me in all my movements. Long as I tread the ground let me not stumble,

verses.sa:
मा नः पश्चान्मा पुरस्तान्नुदिष्ठा मोत्तरादधरादुत।
स्वस्ति भूमे नो भव मा विदन् परिपन्थिनो वरीयो यावया वधम्॥
verses.tr: mā naḥ paścānmā purastānnudiṣṭhā mottarādadharāduta svasti bhūme no bhava mā vidan paripanthino varīyo yāvayā vadham
verses.en: Drive us not from the west or east, drive us not from the north or south. Be gracious unto us, O Earth: let not the robbers find us; keep the deadly weapon far away.

verses.sa:
यावत् तेऽभि विपश्यामि भूमे सूर्येण मेदिना ।
तावन्मे चक्षुर्मा मेष्टोत्तरामुत्तरां समाम्॥
verses.tr: yāvat te'bhi vipaśyāmi bhūme sūryeṇa medinā tāvanme cakṣurmā meṣṭottarāmuttarāṃ samām
verses.en: Long as, on thee, I look around, possessing Surya as. a friend, So long, through each succeeding year, let not my power of vision fail.

verses.sa:
यच्छयानः पर्यावर्ते दक्षिणं सव्यमभि भूमे पार्श्वम् ।
उत्तानास्त्वा प्रतीचीं यत् पृष्टीभिरधिशेमहे ।
मा हिंसीस्तत्र नो भूमे सर्वस्य प्रतिशीवरि॥
verses.tr: yacchayānaḥ paryāvarte dakṣiṇaṃ savyamabhi bhūme pārśvam uttānāstvā pratīcīṃ yat pṛṣṭībhiradhiśemahe mā hiṃsīstatra no bhūme sarvasya pratiśīvari
verses.en: When, as I lie, O Earth, I turn upon my right side l and my left, When stretched at all our length we lay our ribs on thee who meetest us, Do us no injury there, O Earth who furnishest a bed for all.

verses.sa:
यत् ते भूमे विखनामि क्षिप्रं तदपि रोहतु ।
मा ते मर्म विमृग्वरि मा ते हृदयमर्पिपम्॥
verses.tr: yat te bhūme vikhanāmi kṣipraṃ tadapi rohatu mā te marma vimṛgvari mā te hṛdayamarpipam
verses.en: Let what I dig from thee, O Earth, rapidly spring and grow again. O Purifier, let me not pierce through thy vitals or thy heart. l l l

verses.sa:
ग्रीष्मस्ते भूमे वर्षाणि शरद्धेमन्तः शिशिरो वसन्तः ।
ऋतवस्ते विहिता हायनीरहोरात्रे पृथिवि नो दुहाताम्॥
verses.tr: grīṣmaste bhūme varṣāṇi śaraddhemantaḥ śiśiro vasantaḥ ṛtavaste vihitā hāyanīrahorātre pṛthivi no duhātām
verses.en: Earth, may thy summer, and thy rains, and autumn, thy winter, and thy dewy frosts, and spring-time, May thy years, Prithivi! and ordered seasons, and day and night pour out for us abundance,

verses.sa:
याप सर्पं विजमाना विमृग्वरी यस्यामासन्नग्नयो ये अप्स्वन्तः ।
परा दस्यून् ददती देवपीयूनिन्द्रं वृणाना पृथिवी न वृत्रम्।
शक्राय दध्रे वृषभाय वृष्णे॥
verses.tr: yāpa sarpaṃ vijamānā vimṛgvarī yasyāmāsannagnayo ye apsvantaḥ parā dasyūn dadatī devapīyūnindraṃ vṛṇānā pṛthivī na vṛtram śakrāya dadhre vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe
verses.en: The purifier, shrinking from, the Serpent, she who held fires that lie within the waters, Who gives a prey the God-blaspheming Dasyus, Earth choosing Indra for her Lord, not Vritra, hath clung to Sakra, to the Strong and Mighty.

verses.sa:
यस्यां सदोहविर्धाने यूपो यस्यां निमीयते ।
ब्रह्माणो यस्यामर्चन्त्यृग्भिः साम्ना यजुर्विदः।
युज्यन्ते यस्यामृत्विजः सोममिन्द्राय पातवे॥
verses.tr: yasyāṃ sadohavirdhāne yūpo yasyāṃ nimīyate brahmāṇo yasyāmarcantyṛgbhiḥ sāmnā yajurvidaḥ yujyante yasyāmṛtvijaḥ somamindrāya pātave
verses.en: Base of the seat and sheds, on whom the sacrificial stake is reared, On whom the Yajus-knowing priests recite their hymns and chant their psalms, And ministers are busied that Indra may drink the Soma juice;

verses.sa:
यस्यां पूर्वे भूतकृत ऋषयो गा उदानृचुः ।
सप्त सत्रेण वेधसो यज्ञेन तपसा सह॥
verses.tr: yasyāṃ pūrve bhūtakṛta ṛṣayo gā udānṛcuḥ sapta satreṇa vedhaso yajñena tapasā saha
verses.en: On whom the ancient Rishis, they who made the world, sang forth the eows, Seven worshippers, by session, with their fervent zeal and sacrifice;

verses.sa:
सा नो भूमिरा दिशतु यद्धनं कामयामहे ।
भगो अनुप्रयुङ्क्तामिन्द्र एतु पुरोगवः॥
verses.tr: sā no bhūmirā diśatu yaddhanaṃ kāmayāmahe bhago anuprayuṅktāmindra etu purogavaḥ
verses.en: May she, the Earth, assign to us the opulence for which we yearn. May Bhaga share and aid the task and Indra come to lead the way.

verses.sa:
यस्यां गायन्ति नृत्यन्ति भूम्यां मर्त्या व्यैऽलबाः ।
युध्यन्ते यस्यामाक्रन्दो यस्यां वदति दुन्दुभिः ।
सा नो भूमिः प्र णुदतां सपत्नानसपत्नं मा पृथिवी कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: yasyāṃ gāyanti nṛtyanti bhūmyāṃ martyā vyai'labāḥ yudhyante yasyāmākrando yasyāṃ vadati dundubhiḥ sā no bhūmiḥ pra ṇudatāṃ sapatnānasapatnaṃ mā pṛthivī kṛṇotu
verses.en: May she, the Earth, whereon men. sing and dance with varied shout and noise, Whereon men meet in battle, and the war-cry and. the drum resound, May she drive off our foemen, may Prithivi rid me of my foes,

verses.sa:
यस्यामन्नं व्रीहियवौ यस्या इमाः पञ्च कृष्टयः ।
भूम्यै पर्जन्यपत्न्यै नमोऽस्तु वर्षमेदसे॥
verses.tr: yasyāmannaṃ vrīhiyavau yasyā imāḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ bhūmyai parjanyapatnyai namo'stu varṣamedase
verses.en: On whom is food, barley and rice, to whom these Races Five belong, Homage to her, Parjanya's wife, to her whose marrow is the rain! a

verses.sa:
यस्याः पुरो देवकृताः क्षेत्रे यस्या विकुर्वते ।
प्रजापतिः पृथिवीं विश्वगर्भामाशामाशां रण्यां नः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: yasyāḥ puro devakṛtāḥ kṣetre yasyā vikurvate prajāpatiḥ pṛthivīṃ viśvagarbhāmāśāmāśāṃ raṇyāṃ naḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Whose eastles are the work of Gods, and men wage war upon her plain—The Lord of Life make Prithivi, who beareth all things in her womb, pleasant to us on every side! f

verses.sa:
निधिं बिभ्रती बहुधा गुहा वसु मणिं हिरण्यं पृथिवी ददातु मे ।
वसूनि नो वसुदा रासमाना देवी दधातु सुमनस्यमाना॥
verses.tr: nidhiṃ bibhratī bahudhā guhā vasu maṇiṃ hiraṇyaṃ pṛthivī dadātu me vasūni no vasudā rāsamānā devī dadhātu sumanasyamānā
verses.en: May Earth the Goddess, she who bears her treasure stored up in many a place; gold, gems, and riches, Giver of opulence, grant great possessions to us bestowing them with love and favour.

verses.sa:
जनं बिभ्रती बहुधा विवाचसं नानाधर्माणं पृथिवी यथौकसम्।
सहस्रं धारा द्रविणस्य मे दुहां ध्रुवेव धेनुरनपस्फुरन्ती॥
verses.tr: janaṃ bibhratī bahudhā vivācasaṃ nānādharmāṇaṃ pṛthivī yathaukasam sahasraṃ dhārā draviṇasya me duhāṃ dhruveva dhenuranapasphurantī
verses.en: Earth, bearing folk of many a varied language with divers rites as suits their dwelling-places, Pour, like a constant cow that never faileth, a thousand streams of treasure to enrich me!

verses.sa:
यस्ते सर्पो वृश्चिकस्तृष्टदंश्मा हेमन्तजब्धो भृमलो गुहा शये ।
क्रिमिर्जिन्वत् पृथिवि यद्यदेजति प्रावृषि तन्नः सर्पन्मोप सृपद् यच्छिवं तेन नो मृड॥
verses.tr: yaste sarpo vṛścikastṛṣṭadaṃśmā hemantajabdho bhṛmalo guhā śaye krimirjinvat pṛthivi yadyadejati prāvṛṣi tannaḥ sarpanmopa sṛpad yacchivaṃ tena no mṛḍa
verses.en: Thy snake, thy sharply-stinging scorpion, lying concealed, bewildered, chilled with cold of winter, The worm, O Prithivi, each thing that in the Rains revives and stirs, Creeping, forbear to creep on us! With all things gracious bless thou us,

verses.sa:
ये ते पन्थानो बहवो जनायना रथस्य वर्त्मानसश्च यातवे ।
यैः संचरन्त्युभये भद्रपापास्तं पन्थानं जयेमानमित्रमतस्करं यच्छिवं तेन नो मृड॥
verses.tr: ye te panthāno bahavo janāyanā rathasya vartmānasaśca yātave yaiḥ saṃcarantyubhaye bhadrapāpāstaṃ panthānaṃ jayemānamitramataskaraṃ yacchivaṃ tena no mṛḍa
verses.en: Thy many ways on which the people travel, the road for car and wain to journey over, Thereon meet both the good and bad, that pathway may we attain without a foe or robber. With all things gracious bless thou us, l;

verses.sa:
मल्वं बिभ्रती गुरुभृद् भद्रपापस्य निधनं तितिक्षुः ।
वराहेण पृथिवी संविदाना सूकराय वि जिहीते मृगाय॥
verses.tr: malvaṃ bibhratī gurubhṛd bhadrapāpasya nidhanaṃ titikṣuḥ varāheṇa pṛthivī saṃvidānā sūkarāya vi jihīte mṛgāya
verses.en: Supporting both the foolish and the weighty she bears the death both of the good and evil. In friendly concord with the boar, Earth opens herself for the wild swine that roams the forest,

verses.sa:
ये त आरण्याः पशवो मृगा वने हिताः सिंहा व्याघ्राः पुरुषादश्चरन्ति ।
उलं वृकं पृथिवि दुच्छुनामित ऋक्षीकां रक्षो अप बाधयास्मत्॥
verses.tr: ye ta āraṇyāḥ paśavo mṛgā vane hitāḥ siṃhā vyāghrāḥ puruṣādaścaranti ulaṃ vṛkaṃ pṛthivi ducchunāmita ṛkṣīkāṃ rakṣo apa bādhayāsmat
verses.en: All sylvan beasts of thine that love the woodlands, man-eaters, forest-haunting, lions, tigers, Hyena, wolf, Misfortune, evil spirit, drive from us, chase the demons to a distance, f

verses.sa:
ये गन्धर्वा अप्सरसो ये चारायाः किमीदिनः ।
पिशाचान्त्सर्वा रक्षांसि तानस्मद् भूमे यावय॥
verses.tr: ye gandharvā apsaraso ye cārāyāḥ kimīdinaḥ piśācāntsarvā rakṣāṃsi tānasmad bhūme yāvaya
verses.en: Gandharvas and Apsarases, Kimidins, and malignant sprites, Pisachas all, and Rakshasas, these keep thou, Earth! afar from us.

verses.sa:
यां द्विपादः पक्षिणः संपतन्ति हंसाः सुपर्णाः शकुना वयांसि ।
यस्यां वातो मातरिश्वेयते रजांसि कृण्वंश्च्यावयंश्च वृक्षान्।
वातस्य प्रवामुपवामनु वात्यर्चिः॥
verses.tr: yāṃ dvipādaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ saṃpatanti haṃsāḥ suparṇāḥ śakunā vayāṃsi yasyāṃ vāto mātariśveyate rajāṃsi kṛṇvaṃścyāvayaṃśca vṛkṣān vātasya pravāmupavāmanu vātyarciḥ
verses.en: To whom the winged bipeds fly together, birds of each various kind, the swans, the eagles; On whom the Wind comes rushing, Matarisvan, rousing the dust and causing trees to tremble, and flame pursues the blast hither and thither;

verses.sa:
यस्यां कृष्णमरुणं च संहिते अहोरात्रे विहिते भूम्यामधि ।
वर्षेण भूमिः पृथिवी वृतावृता सा नो दधातु भद्रया प्रिये धामनिधामनि॥
verses.tr: yasyāṃ kṛṣṇamaruṇaṃ ca saṃhite ahorātre vihite bhūmyāmadhi varṣeṇa bhūmiḥ pṛthivī vṛtāvṛtā sā no dadhātu bhadrayā priye dhāmanidhāmani
verses.en: Earth, upon whom are settled, joined together, the night and day, the dusky and the ruddy, Prithivi compassed by the rain about her, Happily may she stablish us in each delightful dwelling place.

verses.sa:
द्यौश्च म इदं पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षं च मे व्यचः ।
अग्निः सूर्य आपो मेधां विश्वे देवाश्च सं ददुः॥
verses.tr: dyauśca ma idaṃ pṛthivī cāntarikṣaṃ ca me vyacaḥ agniḥ sūrya āpo medhāṃ viśve devāśca saṃ daduḥ
verses.en: Heaven, Earth, the realm of Middle Air have granted me this ample room, Agni, Sun, Waters, all the Gods have joined to give me mental power,

verses.sa:
अहमस्मि सहमान उत्तरो नाम भूम्याम्।
अभीषाडस्मि विश्वाषाडाशामाशां विषासहिः॥
verses.tr: ahamasmi sahamāna uttaro nāma bhūmyām abhīṣāḍasmi viśvāṣāḍāśāmāśāṃ viṣāsahiḥ
verses.en: I am victorious, I am called the lord superior on earth, Triumphant, all-o'erpowering, the conqueror en every side,

verses.sa:
अदो यद् देवि प्रथमाना पुरस्ताद् देवैरुक्ता व्यसर्पो महित्वम्।
आ त्वा सुभूतमविशत् तदानीमकल्पयथाः प्रदिशश्चतस्रः॥
verses.tr: ado yad devi prathamānā purastād devairuktā vyasarpo mahitvam ā tvā subhūtamaviśat tadānīmakalpayathāḥ pradiśaścatasraḥ
verses.en: There, when the Gods, O Goddess, named thee, spreading thy wide expanse as thou wast broadening eastward, Then into thee passed many a charm and glory: thou madest for thyself the world's four regions.

verses.sa:
ये ग्रामा यदरण्यं याः सभा अधि भूम्याम्।
ये संग्रामाः समितयस्तेषु चारु वदेम ते॥
verses.tr: ye grāmā yadaraṇyaṃ yāḥ sabhā adhi bhūmyām ye saṃgrāmāḥ samitayasteṣu cāru vadema te
verses.en: In hamlets and in woodland, and in all assemblages on earth, In gatherings, meeting of the folk, we will speak glorious things of thee.

verses.sa:
अश्व इव रजो दुधुवे वि तान् जनान् य आक्षियन् पृथिवीं यादजायत ।
मन्द्राग्रेत्वरी भुवनस्य गोपा वनस्पतीनां गृभिरोषधीनाम्॥
verses.tr: aśva iva rajo dudhuve vi tān janān ya ākṣiyan pṛthivīṃ yādajāyata mandrāgretvarī bhuvanasya gopā vanaspatīnāṃ gṛbhiroṣadhīnām
verses.en: As the horse scattereth the dust, the people who dwelt upon the land, at birth, she scattered, Leader and head of all the world, delightful, the trees' protectress and the plants' upholder.

verses.sa:
यद् वदामि मधुमत् तद् वदामि यदीक्षे तद् वनन्ति मा ।
त्विषीमानस्मि जूतिमानवान्यान् हन्मि दोधतः॥
verses.tr: yad vadāmi madhumat tad vadāmi yadīkṣe tad vananti mā tviṣīmānasmi jūtimānavānyān hanmi dodhataḥ
verses.en: Whatever I say I speak with honey-sweetness, whatever I behold for that they love me, 'Dazzling, impetuous am I; others who fiercely stir I slay.

verses.sa:
शन्तिवा सुरभिः स्योना कीलालोध्नी पयस्वती ।
भूमिरधि ब्रवीतु मे पृथिवी पयसा सह॥
verses.tr: śantivā surabhiḥ syonā kīlālodhnī payasvatī bhūmiradhi bravītu me pṛthivī payasā saha
verses.en: Mild, gracious, sweetly odorous, milky, with nectar in her breast, May Earth, may Prithivi bestow her benison, with v milk, on me,

verses.sa:
यामन्वैच्छद्धविषा विश्वकर्मान्तरर्णवे रजसि प्रविष्टाम्।
भुजिष्यं१ पात्रं निहितं गुहा यदाविर्भोगे अभवन्मातृमद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: yāmanvaicchaddhaviṣā viśvakarmāntararṇave rajasi praviṣṭām bhujiṣyaṃ1 pātraṃ nihitaṃ guhā yadāvirbhoge abhavanmātṛmadbhyaḥ
verses.en: Whom Visvakarman with oblation followed, when she was set in mid-air's billowy ocean—A. useful vessel, hid, when, for enjoyment, she was y made manifest to those with mothers,

verses.sa:
त्वमस्यावपनी जनानामदितिः कामदुघा पप्रथाना।
यत् त ऊनं तत् त आ पूरयाति प्रजापतिः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य॥
verses.tr: tvamasyāvapanī janānāmaditiḥ kāmadughā paprathānā yat ta ūnaṃ tat ta ā pūrayāti prajāpatiḥ prathamajā ṛtasya
verses.en: Thou art the vessel that containeth people, Aditi, granter of the wish, far-spreading. Prajapati, the first-born Son of Order, supplieth thee with whatsoe'er thou lakes.

verses.sa:
उपस्थास्ते अनमीवा अयक्ष्मा अस्मभ्यं सन्तु पृथिवि प्रसूताः ।
दीर्घं न आयुः प्रतिबुध्यमाना वयं तुभ्यं बलिहृतः स्याम॥
verses.tr: upasthāste anamīvā ayakṣmā asmabhyaṃ santu pṛthivi prasūtāḥ dīrghaṃ na āyuḥ pratibudhyamānā vayaṃ tubhyaṃ balihṛtaḥ syāma
verses.en: Let thy breasts, free from sickness and Consumption, be, Prithivi, produced for our advantage. Through long-extended life wakeful and watching still may we be thy tributary servants.

verses.sa:
भूमे मातर्नि धेहि मा भद्रया सुप्रतिष्ठितम्।
संविदाना दिवा कवे श्रियां मा धेहि भूत्याम्॥
verses.tr: bhūme mātarni dhehi mā bhadrayā supratiṣṭhitam saṃvidānā divā kave śriyāṃ mā dhehi bhūtyām
verses.en: O Earth, my Mother, set thou me happily in a place secure, Of one accord with Heaven, O Sage, set me in glory and in wealth.

sections.label: A funeral hymn, and deprecation of Agni the Consumer of corpses
sections.name: Book 12, hymn 2

verses.sa:
नडमा रोह न ते अत्र लोक इदं सीसं भागधेयं त एहि ।
यो गोषु यक्ष्मः पुरुषेषु यक्ष्मस्तेन त्वं साकमधराङ् परेहि॥
verses.tr: naḍamā roha na te atra loka idaṃ sīsaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ ta ehi yo goṣu yakṣmaḥ puruṣeṣu yakṣmastena tvaṃ sākamadharāṅ parehi
verses.en: This is no place to hold thee; mount the Nada: this lead is thine appointed share, Come hither. Together with Consumption in the cattle, Consumption in our men, go hence, go southward.

verses.sa:
अघशंसदुःशंसाभ्यां करेणानुकरेण च ।
यक्ष्मं च सर्वं तेनेतो मृत्युं च निरजामसि॥
verses.tr: aghaśaṃsaduḥśaṃsābhyāṃ kareṇānukareṇa ca yakṣmaṃ ca sarvaṃ teneto mṛtyuṃ ca nirajāmasi
verses.en: With this we chase and banish all consumptive malady and Death, With sinner and malicious man, with helper and with minister.

verses.sa:
निरितो मृत्युं निरृतिं निररातिमजामसि ।
यो नो द्वेष्टि तमद्ध्यग्ने अक्रव्याद् यमु द्विष्मस्तमु ते प्र सुवामसि॥
verses.tr: nirito mṛtyuṃ nirṛtiṃ nirarātimajāmasi yo no dveṣṭi tamaddhyagne akravyād yamu dviṣmastamu te pra suvāmasi
verses.en: Death and Misfortune we expel, Malignity we drive away. O Agni, thou who eatest not the corpse, eat him who hateth us: him whom we hate we send to thee.

verses.sa:
यद्यग्निः क्रव्याद् यदि वा व्याघ्र इमं गोष्ठं प्रविवेशान्योकाः ।
तं माषाज्यं कृत्वा प्र हिणोमि दूरं स गच्छत्वप्सुषदोऽप्यग्नीन्॥
verses.tr: yadyagniḥ kravyād yadi vā vyāghra imaṃ goṣṭhaṃ praviveśānyokāḥ taṃ māṣājyaṃ kṛtvā pra hiṇomi dūraṃ sa gacchatvapsuṣado'pyagnīn
verses.en: If the corpse-eating Agni, or a tiger leaving his lair, hath entered this our homestead, With beans prepared in butter I expel him: far let him go to fires that lie in waters,

verses.sa:
यत् त्वा क्रुद्धाः प्रचक्रुर्मन्युना पुरुषे मृते।
सुकल्पमग्ने तत् त्वया पुनस्त्वोद् दीपयामसि॥
verses.tr: yat tvā kruddhāḥ pracakrurmanyunā puruṣe mṛte sukalpamagne tat tvayā punastvod dīpayāmasi
verses.en: When, angered that aman hath died, we in our wrath have banished thee, That deed is easily set right through thee: we kindle thee again, C

verses.sa:
पुनस्त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः पुनर्ब्रह्मा वसुनीतिरग्ने ।
पुनस्त्वा ब्रह्मणस्पतिराधाद् दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय॥
verses.tr: punastvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ punarbrahmā vasunītiragne punastvā brahmaṇaspatirādhād dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya
verses.en: Again have the Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, the Brahman, bringer of good things, O Agni, Again hath Brahmanaspati disposed thee for long life lasting through a hundred autumns,

verses.sa:
यो अग्निः क्रव्यात् प्रविवेश नो गृहमिमं पश्यन्नितरं जातवेदसम्।
तं हरामि पितृयज्ञाय दूरं स घर्ममिन्धां परमे सधस्थे॥
verses.tr: yo agniḥ kravyāt praviveśa no gṛhamimaṃ paśyannitaraṃ jātavedasam taṃ harāmi pitṛyajñāya dūraṃ sa gharmamindhāṃ parame sadhasthe
verses.en: I sweep afar, for sacrifice to Fathers, corpse-eating Agni who hath come among us Although he saw this other, Jatavedas: in loftiest space let him inflame the caldron,

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादमग्निं प्र हिणोमि दूरं यमराज्ञो गच्छतु रिप्रवाहः ।
इहायमितरो जातवेदा देवो देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: kravyādamagniṃ pra hiṇomi dūraṃ yamarājño gacchatu ripravāhaḥ ihāyamitaro jātavedā devo devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan
verses.en: I drive corpse-eating Agni to a distance: sin-laden let him go to Yamas vassals. Here let this other, Jatavedas, carry oblation to the Deities, foreknowing.

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादमग्निमिषितो हरामि जनान् दृंहन्तं वज्रेण मृत्युम्।
नि तं शास्मि गार्हपत्येन विद्वान् पितृणां लोकेऽपि भागो अस्तु॥
verses.tr: kravyādamagnimiṣito harāmi janān dṛṃhantaṃ vajreṇa mṛtyum ni taṃ śāsmi gārhapatyena vidvān pitṛṇāṃ loke'pi bhāgo astu
verses.en: I quickly sweep away corpse-eating Agni, Death, with his bolt depriving men of motion, From household fire, well-knowing, I divide him: so in the world of Fathers be his portion.

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादमग्निं शशमानमुक्थ्यं१ हिणोमि पथिभिः पितृयाणैः ।
मा देवयानैः पुनरा गा अत्रैवैधि पितृषु जागृहि त्वम्॥
verses.tr: kravyādamagniṃ śaśamānamukthyaṃ1 hiṇomi pathibhiḥ pitṛyāṇaiḥ mā devayānaiḥ punarā gā atraivaidhi pitṛṣu jāgṛhi tvam
verses.en: Corpse-eating Agni, toil-worn, meet for praises, I send away by paths used by the Fathers. Stay there; keep watch among the Fathers: come not again to us by ways whereon Gods travel,

verses.sa:
समिन्धते संकसुकं स्वस्तये शुद्धा भवन्तः शुचयः पावकाः ।
जहाति रिप्रमत्येन एति समिद्धो अग्निः सुपुना पुनाति॥
verses.tr: samindhate saṃkasukaṃ svastaye śuddhā bhavantaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ jahāti ripramatyena eti samiddho agniḥ supunā punāti
verses.en: They being cleansed and bright, the 'purifiers, kindle Sankasuka for our well-being, Impurity leaveth us and sin departeth: lighted by the good cleanser Agni cleanseth.

verses.sa:
देवो अग्निः संकसुको दिवस्पृष्ठान्यारुहत्।
मुच्यमानो निरेणसोऽमोगस्मां अशस्त्याः॥
verses.tr: devo agniḥ saṃkasuko divaspṛṣṭhānyāruhat mucyamāno nireṇaso'mogasmāṃ aśastyāḥ
verses.en: Agni the God, the Breaker-up, hath mounted to the heights of heaven. Released from all transgression, he hath from the curse delivered us,

verses.sa:
अस्मिन् वयं संकसुके अग्नौ रिप्राणि मृज्महे ।
अभूम यज्ञियाः शुद्धाः प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: asmin vayaṃ saṃkasuke agnau riprāṇi mṛjmahe abhūma yajñiyāḥ śuddhāḥ pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: On Agni here, the Breaker-up, we wipe impurities away. Cleansed, fit for sacrifice have we become: may he prolong our lives,

verses.sa:
संकसुको विकसुको निरृथो यश्च निस्वरः ।
ते ते यक्ष्मं सवेदसो दूराद् दूरमनीनशन्॥
verses.tr: saṃkasuko vikasuko nirṛtho yaśca nisvaraḥ te te yakṣmaṃ savedaso dūrād dūramanīnaśan
verses.en: The Breaker-up, the Burster, the Destroyer, and the Silent One, These have expelled Consumption far, far off from thee and all thou hast,

verses.sa:
यो नो अश्वेषु वीरेषु यो नो गोष्वजाविषु ।
क्रव्यादं निर्णुदामसि यो अग्निर्जनयोपनः॥
verses.tr: yo no aśveṣu vīreṣu yo no goṣvajāviṣu kravyādaṃ nirṇudāmasi yo agnirjanayopanaḥ
verses.en: Corpse-eating Agni we expel, the Agni who bewilders men Him who is in our horses, in our heroes, cows, and goats, and sheep:

verses.sa:
अन्येभ्यस्त्वा पुरुषेभ्यो गोभ्यो अश्वेभ्यस्त्वा ।
निः क्रव्यादं नुदामसि यो अग्निर्जीवितयोपनः॥
verses.tr: anyebhyastvā puruṣebhyo gobhyo aśvebhyastvā niḥ kravyādaṃ nudāmasi yo agnirjīvitayopanaḥ
verses.en: We drive thee forth to other folk, to alien cattle, alien steeds, S Thee the corpse-eating Agni, thee the Agni who bewilders men.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् देवा अमृजत यस्मिन् मनुष्याऽ उत।
तस्मिन् घृतस्तावो मृष्ट्वा त्वमग्ने दिवं रुह॥
verses.tr: yasmin devā amṛjata yasmin manuṣyā' uta tasmin ghṛtastāvo mṛṣṭvā tvamagne divaṃ ruha
verses.en: Whereon the Deities, whereon men too have purified themselves, Exalting fatness, cleanse thyself, Agni, therein and mount to heaven.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्न आहुत स नो माभ्यपक्रमीः ।
अत्रैव दीदिहि द्यवि ज्योक् च सूर्यं दृशे॥
verses.tr: samiddho agna āhuta sa no mābhyapakramīḥ atraiva dīdihi dyavi jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe
verses.en: O Agni, kindled and adored, turn notaway to visit us. Shine brightly even there in heaven, so that we Jong may see the Sun.

verses.sa:
सीसे मृड्ढ्वं नडे मृड्ढ्वमग्नौ संकसुके च यत्।
अथो अव्यां रामायां शीर्षक्तिमुपबर्हणे॥
verses.tr: sīse mṛḍḍhvaṃ naḍe mṛḍḍhvamagnau saṃkasuke ca yat atho avyāṃ rāmāyāṃ śīrṣaktimupabarhaṇe
verses.en: Wipe all away on lead and reed, on Agni, him who breaketh up, Then on a black-hued sheep, and on a cushion pain that racks the head.

verses.sa:
सीसे मलं सादयित्वा शीर्षक्तिमुपबर्हणे ।
अव्यामसिक्न्यां मृष्ट्वा शुद्धा भवत यज्ञियाः॥
verses.tr: sīse malaṃ sādayitvā śīrṣaktimupabarhaṇe avyāmasiknyāṃ mṛṣṭvā śuddhā bhavata yajñiyāḥ
verses.en: Wipe off pollution, lay it in the lead and in the black-hued sheep, And headache in the- cushion; then be cleansed and fit to sacrifice.

verses.sa:
परं मृत्यो अनु परेहि पन्थां यस्त एष इतरो देवयानात्।
चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमीहेमे वीरा बहवो भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: paraṃ mṛtyo anu parehi panthāṃ yasta eṣa itaro devayānāt cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmīheme vīrā bahavo bhavantu
verses.en: Go onward, Death, pursue thy special pathway apart from that which Gods are wont to travel. To thee I say it who hast eyes and hearest; great grow the number of these men around us!

verses.sa:
इमे जीवा वि मृतैराववृत्रन्नभूद् भद्रा देवहुतिर्नो अद्य।
प्राञ्चो अगाम नृतये हसाय सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम॥
verses.tr: ime jīvā vi mṛtairāvavṛtrannabhūd bhadrā devahutirno adya prāñco agāma nṛtaye hasāya suvīrāso vidathamā vadema
verses.en: Divided from the dead are these, the living: now is our calling on the Gods successful, We have gone forth for dancing and for laughter: may we with brave sons speak to the assembly.

verses.sa:
इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि मैषां नु गादपरो अर्थमेतम्।
शतं जीवन्तः शरदः पुरूचीस्तिरो मृत्युं दधतां पर्वतेन॥
verses.tr: imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi maiṣāṃ nu gādaparo arthametam śataṃ jīvantaḥ śaradaḥ purūcīstiro mṛtyuṃ dadhatāṃ parvatena
verses.en: Here I erect this rampart for the living: let none of these, none other, reach this limit, May they survive a hundred lengthened autumns, and may they bury Death beneath this mountain, Current Cr Cen dear Cs Res

verses.sa:
आ रोहतायुर्जरसं वृणाना अनुपूर्वं यतमाना यति स्थ।
तान् वस्त्वष्टा सुजनिमा सजोषाः सर्वमायुर्नयतु जीवनाय॥
verses.tr: ā rohatāyurjarasaṃ vṛṇānā anupūrvaṃ yatamānā yati stha tān vastvaṣṭā sujanimā sajoṣāḥ sarvamāyurnayatu jīvanāya
verses.en: Live your full lives and find old age delightful, all of you striving, one behind the other, May Tvashtar, maker of fair things, be gracious, and lead your whole lives on to full existence,

verses.sa:
यथाहान्यनुपूर्वं भवन्ति यथर्तव ऋतुभिर्यन्ति साकम्।
यथा न पूर्वमपरो जहात्येवा धातरायूंषि कल्पयैषाम्॥
verses.tr: yathāhānyanupūrvaṃ bhavanti yathartava ṛtubhiryanti sākam yathā na pūrvamaparo jahātyevā dhātarāyūṃṣi kalpayaiṣām
verses.en: As the days follow days in close succession, as with the seasons duly come the seasons, As each successor fails not his foregoer, so constitute the lives of these, Ordainer!

verses.sa:
अश्मन्वती रीयते सं रभध्वं वीरयध्वं प्र तरता सखायः ।
अत्रा जहीत ये असन् दुरेवा अनमीवानुत्तरेमाभि वाजान्॥
verses.tr: aśmanvatī rīyate saṃ rabhadhvaṃ vīrayadhvaṃ pra taratā sakhāyaḥ atrā jahīta ye asan durevā anamīvānuttaremābhi vājān
verses.en: Gather your strength, my friends; the stream flows stony: acquit yourselves as men, and cross the river. Abandon here the powers that were malignant, and let us cross to powers exempt from sickness.

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठता प्र तरता सखायोऽश्मन्वती नदी स्यन्दत इयम्।
अत्रा जहीत ये असन्नशिवाः शिवान्त्स्योनानुत्तरेमाभि वाजान्॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭhatā pra taratā sakhāyo'śmanvatī nadī syandata iyam atrā jahīta ye asannaśivāḥ śivāntsyonānuttaremābhi vājān
verses.en: Rise up erect, cross over, my companions: the stream is stony that? flows here before us, Abandon here the powers that were ungracious, and let us cross to powers benign and friendly.

verses.sa:
वैश्वदेवीं वर्चस आ रभध्वं शुद्धा भवन्तः शुचयः पावकाः ।
अतिक्रामन्तो दुरिता पदानि शतं हिमाः सर्ववीरा मदेम॥
verses.tr: vaiśvadevīṃ varcasa ā rabhadhvaṃ śuddhā bhavantaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ atikrāmanto duritā padāni śataṃ himāḥ sarvavīrā madema
verses.en: Becoming pure and bright and purifying begin the Vaisvadevi strain for splendour, May we rejoice, o'erpassing troublous places, with all our heroes through a hundred winters,

verses.sa:
उदीचीनैः पथिभिर्वायुमद्भिरतिक्रामन्तोऽवरान् परेभिः ।
त्रिः सप्त कृत्व ऋषयः परेता मृत्युं प्रत्यौहन् पदयोपनेन॥
verses.tr: udīcīnaiḥ pathibhirvāyumadbhiratikrāmanto'varān parebhiḥ triḥ sapta kṛtva ṛṣayaḥ paretā mṛtyuṃ pratyauhan padayopanena
verses.en: On pathways swept by wind, directed upward, passing beyond the lower, on the higher, Thrice seven times have the Rishis, the Departed, forced Mrityu backward with the fastened fetter.

verses.sa:
मृत्योः पदं योपयन्त एत द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ।
आसीना मृत्युं नुदता सधस्थेऽथ जीवासो विदथमा वदेम॥
verses.tr: mṛtyoḥ padaṃ yopayanta eta drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ āsīnā mṛtyuṃ nudatā sadhasthe'tha jīvāso vidathamā vadema
verses.en: Effacing Mrityu's footstep ye came hither, to further times prolonging your existence. Seated, drive Mrityu to his proper dwelling: then may we, living, speak to the assembly.

verses.sa:
इमा नारीरविधवाः सुपत्नीराञ्जनेन सर्पिषा सं स्पृशन्ताम्।
अनश्रवो अनमीवाः सुरत्ना आ रोहन्तु जनयो योनिमग्रे॥
verses.tr: imā nārīravidhavāḥ supatnīrāñjanena sarpiṣā saṃ spṛśantām anaśravo anamīvāḥ suratnā ā rohantu janayo yonimagre
verses.en: Let these unwidowed dames with goodly husbands adorn themselves with fragrant balm and unguent. Decked with fair jewels, tearless, sound and healthy, first let the dames go up to where he lieth.

verses.sa:
व्याकरोमि हविषाहमेतौ तौ ब्रह्मणा व्य१हं कल्पयामि ।
स्वधां पितृभ्यो अजरां कृणोमि दीर्घेणायुषा समिमान्त्सृजामि॥
verses.tr: vyākaromi haviṣāhametau tau brahmaṇā vya1haṃ kalpayāmi svadhāṃ pitṛbhyo ajarāṃ kṛṇomi dīrgheṇāyuṣā samimāntsṛjāmi
verses.en: I with oblation separate both classes, and with my prayer dispart their several portions. I offer food that wastes not to the "Fathers, and to these men give life of long duration,

verses.sa:
यो नो अग्निः पितरो हृत्स्व१न्तराविवेशामृतो मर्त्येषु ।
मय्यहं तं परि गृह्णामि देवं मा सो अस्मान् द्विक्षत मा वयं तम्॥
verses.tr: yo no agniḥ pitaro hṛtsva1ntarāviveśāmṛto martyeṣu mayyahaṃ taṃ pari gṛhṇāmi devaṃ mā so asmān dvikṣata mā vayaṃ tam
verses.en: That Agni, Fathers! who, himself. immortal, hath entered and possessed our mortal bosoms, Even him I grasp and hold the God within me, Let him not hate us, may we never hate him.

verses.sa:
अपावृत्य गार्हपत्यात् क्रव्यादा प्रेत दक्षिणा।
प्रियं पितृभ्य आत्मने ब्रह्मभ्यः कृणुता प्रियम्॥
verses.tr: apāvṛtya gārhapatyāt kravyādā preta dakṣiṇā priyaṃ pitṛbhya ātmane brahmabhyaḥ kṛṇutā priyam
verses.en: When ye have left the household fire, with the Corpse-eater southward go, Do that which is delightful to the Fathers, Brahmans, and yourselves.

verses.sa:
द्विभागधनमादाय प्र क्षिणात्यवर्त्या ।
अग्निः पुत्रस्य ज्येष्ठस्य यः क्रव्यादनिराहितः॥
verses.tr: dvibhāgadhanamādāya pra kṣiṇātyavartyā agniḥ putrasya jyeṣṭhasya yaḥ kravyādanirāhitaḥ
verses.en: Agni, the banqueter on flesh, not banished, for the eldest son Taketh a double share of wealth and spoiler it with poverty,

verses.sa:
यत् कृषते यद् वनुते यच्च वस्नेन विन्दते ।
सर्वं मर्त्यस्य तन्नास्ति क्रव्याच्चेदनिराहितः॥
verses.tr: yat kṛṣate yad vanute yacca vasnena vindate sarvaṃ martyasya tannāsti kravyāccedanirāhitaḥ
verses.en: What man acquires by plough, by war, all that he wins by toil of hand, He loses all if Agni the Carnivorous be not set aside.

verses.sa:
अयज्ञियो हतवर्चा भवति नैनेन हविरत्तवे ।
छिनत्ति कृष्या गोर्धनाद् यं क्रव्यादनुवर्तते॥
verses.tr: ayajñiyo hatavarcā bhavati nainena havirattave chinatti kṛṣyā gordhanād yaṃ kravyādanuvartate
verses.en: Unholy, splendour-reft is he, his sacrifice unfit to eat, Krayad deprives of tilth, of cow, of riches him whom he pursues.

verses.sa:
मुहुर्गृध्यैः प्र वदत्यार्तिं मर्त्यो नीत्य ।
क्रव्याद् यानग्निरन्तिकादनुविद्वान् वितावति॥
verses.tr: muhurgṛdhyaiḥ pra vadatyārtiṃ martyo nītya kravyād yānagnirantikādanuvidvān vitāvati
verses.en: Oft as a greedy beggar speaks the mortal who has brought distress, Those whom Carnivorous Agni close at hand runs after and detects.

verses.sa:
ग्राह्या गृहाः सं सृज्यन्ते स्त्रिया यन्म्रियते पतिः ।
ब्रह्मैव विद्वानेष्यो३ यः क्रव्यादं निरादधत्॥
verses.tr: grāhyā gṛhāḥ saṃ sṛjyante striyā yanmriyate patiḥ brahmaiva vidvāneṣyo3 yaḥ kravyādaṃ nirādadhat
verses.en: When a dame's husband dies the house is tangled fast in Grahi's net. A learned Brahman must be sought to drive Carnivorous Agni forth.

verses.sa:
यद् रिप्रं शमलं चकृम यच्च दुष्कृतम्।
आपो मा तस्माच्छुम्भन्त्वग्नेः संकसुकाच्च यत्॥
verses.tr: yad ripraṃ śamalaṃ cakṛma yacca duṣkṛtam āpo mā tasmācchumbhantvagneḥ saṃkasukācca yat
verses.en: From any evil we have done, act of impurity or sin, Let waters purge me and from all that comes from Agni Breaker-up,

verses.sa:
ता अधरादुदीचीराववृत्रन् प्रजानतीः पथिभिर्देवयानैः ।
पर्वतस्य वृषभस्याधि पृष्ठे नवाश्चरन्ति सरितः पुराणीः॥
verses.tr: tā adharādudīcīrāvavṛtran prajānatīḥ pathibhirdevayānaiḥ parvatasya vṛṣabhasyādhi pṛṣṭhe navāścaranti saritaḥ purāṇīḥ
verses.en: By pathways travelled by the Gods these waters, well-knowing, from below have mounted upward. High on the summit of the raining mountain the ancient rivers fresh and new are flowing.

verses.sa: अग्ने अक्रव्यान्निः क्रव्यादं नुदा देवयजनं वह॥
verses.tr: agne akravyānniḥ kravyādaṃ nudā devayajanaṃ vaha
verses.en: Drive off Carnivorous Agni, thou Agni who eatest not the flesh; carry oblation paid to Gods.

verses.sa:
इमं क्रव्यादा विवेशायं क्रव्यादमन्वगात्।
व्याग्रौ कृत्वा नानानं तं हरामि शिवापरम्॥
verses.tr: imaṃ kravyādā viveśāyaṃ kravyādamanvagāt vyāgrau kṛtvā nānānaṃ taṃ harāmi śivāparam
verses.en: The Flesh-eater hath entered him: he hath pursued the Flesh-eater. Making two tigers different-wise, I bear away the ungracious one.

verses.sa: अन्तर्धिर्देवानां परिधिर्मनुष्याऽणामग्निर्गार्हपत्य उभयानन्तरा श्रितः॥
verses.tr: antardhirdevānāṃ paridhirmanuṣyā'ṇāmagnirgārhapatya ubhayānantarā śritaḥ
verses.en: He who holds Gods within himself, the rampart and defence of men, Agni, the sacred household fire, hath come and stands between them both.

verses.sa:
जीवानामायुः प्र तिर त्वमग्ने पितॄणां लोकमपि गच्छन्तु ये मृताः ।
सुगार्हपत्यो वितपन्नरातिमुषामुषां श्रेयसीं धेह्यस्मै॥
verses.tr: jīvānāmāyuḥ pra tira tvamagne pitṝṇāṃ lokamapi gacchantu ye mṛtāḥ sugārhapatyo vitapannarātimuṣāmuṣāṃ śreyasīṃ dhehyasmai
verses.en: Prolong the lives of those who live, O. Agni, Let the dead go unto the world of Fathers, As goodly household fire burn up Arati; give this man dawn brighter than all the mornings,

verses.sa: सर्वानग्ने सहमानः सपत्नानैषामूर्जं रयिमस्मासु धेहि॥
verses.tr: sarvānagne sahamānaḥ sapatnānaiṣāmūrjaṃ rayimasmāsu dhehi
verses.en: Subduing all our adversaries, Agni, give us their food, their strength and their possessions,

verses.sa:
इममिन्द्रं वह्निं पप्रिमन्वारभध्वं स वो निर्वक्षद् दुरितादवद्यात्।
तेनाप हत शरुमापतन्तं तेन रुद्रस्य परि पातास्ताम्॥
verses.tr: imamindraṃ vahniṃ paprimanvārabhadhvaṃ sa vo nirvakṣad duritādavadyāt tenāpa hata śarumāpatantaṃ tena rudrasya pari pātāstām
verses.en: Grasp ye this Indra, furtherer, satisfier: he will release you from disgrace and trouble. With him drive back the shaft that flies against you,- with him ward off the missile shot by Rudra.

verses.sa:
अनड्वाहं प्लवमन्वारभध्वं स वो निर्वक्षद् दुरितादवद्यात्।
आ रोहत सवितुर्नावमेतां षड्भिरुर्वीभिरमतिं तरेम॥
verses.tr: anaḍvāhaṃ plavamanvārabhadhvaṃ sa vo nirvakṣad duritādavadyāt ā rohata saviturnāvametāṃ ṣaḍbhirurvībhiramatiṃ tarema
verses.en: Seize with firm hold the Ox who boundeth forward: he will uplift you from disgrace and trouble. Enter this ship of Savitar; let us flee from poverty over all the six expanses,

verses.sa:
अहोरात्रे अन्वेषि बिभ्रत् क्षेम्यस्तिष्ठन् प्रतरणः सुवीरः ।
अनातुरान्त्सुमनसस्तल्प बिभ्रज्ज्योगेव नः पुरुषगन्धिरेधि॥
verses.tr: ahorātre anveṣi bibhrat kṣemyastiṣṭhan prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ anāturāntsumanasastalpa bibhrajjyogeva naḥ puruṣagandhiredhi
verses.en: Thou followest the day and night, supporting, standing, at peace, promoting, rich in heroes, Long, bearing undiseased and happy sleepers, be ours, O Bed, with smell of man about thee.

verses.sa:
ते देवेभ्य आ वृश्चन्ते पापं जीवन्ति सर्वदा।
क्रव्याद् यानग्निरन्तिकादश्व इवानुवपते नडम्॥
verses.tr: te devebhya ā vṛścante pāpaṃ jīvanti sarvadā kravyād yānagnirantikādaśva ivānuvapate naḍam
verses.en: They sever from the Gods, they live in sin and misery evermore, Those whom from very near at hand Carnivorous Agni casteth down as a horse tramples down the reeds,

verses.sa:
येऽश्रद्धा धनकाम्या क्रव्यादा समासते ।
ते वा अन्येषां कुम्भीं पर्यादधति सर्वदा॥
verses.tr: ye'śraddhā dhanakāmyā kravyādā samāsate te vā anyeṣāṃ kumbhīṃ paryādadhati sarvadā
verses.en: The faithless, who from lust of wealth abide with him who feeds on flesh, For ever set upon the fire an alien caldron, not their own.

verses.sa:
प्रेव पिपतिषति मनसा मुहुरा वर्तते पुनः ।
क्रव्याद् यानग्निरन्तिकादनुविद्वान् वितावति॥
verses.tr: preva pipatiṣati manasā muhurā vartate punaḥ kravyād yānagnirantikādanuvidvān vitāvati
verses.en: Forward in spirit would he fly, and often turns he back again, Whomso Carnivorous Agni from anear discovers and torments,

verses.sa:
अविः कृष्णा भागधेयं पशूनां सीसं क्रव्यादपि चन्द्रं त आहुः ।
माषाः पिष्टा भागधेयं ते हव्यमरण्यान्या गह्वरं सचस्व॥
verses.tr: aviḥ kṛṣṇā bhāgadheyaṃ paśūnāṃ sīsaṃ kravyādapi candraṃ ta āhuḥ māṣāḥ piṣṭā bhāgadheyaṃ te havyamaraṇyānyā gahvaraṃ sacasva
verses.en: Among tame beasts the black ewe is thy portion, and the bright lead is thine, they say, Flesh-eater! Mashed beans have been assigned thee for oblation: 'go seek the dark wood and the wildernesses,

verses.sa:
इषीकां जरतीमिष्ट्वा तिल्पिञ्जं दण्डनं नडम्।
तमिन्द्र इध्मं कृत्वा यमस्याग्निं निरादधौ॥
verses.tr: iṣīkāṃ jaratīmiṣṭvā tilpiñjaṃ daṇḍanaṃ naḍam tamindra idhmaṃ kṛtvā yamasyāgniṃ nirādadhau
verses.en: I sought the rustling sugar-cane, white Sesamum, and cane and reed, I made this Indra's fuel, and the Fire of Yama I removed.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यञ्चमर्कं प्रत्यर्पयित्वा प्रविद्वान् पन्थां वि ह्याऽविवेश ।
परामीषामसून् दिदेश दीर्घेणायुषा समिमान्त्सृजामि॥
verses.tr: pratyañcamarkaṃ pratyarpayitvā pravidvān panthāṃ vi hyā'viveśa parāmīṣāmasūn dideśa dīrgheṇāyuṣā samimāntsṛjāmi
verses.en: Against the sinking western Sun I set them; each sundered path, knowing my way, I entered. I have warned off the ghosts of the Departed: to these I give the boon of long existence.

verses.sa:
पुमान् पुंसोऽधि तिष्ठ चर्मेहि तत्र ह्वयस्व यतमा प्रिया ते ।
यावन्तावग्रे प्रथमं समेयथुस्तद् वां वयो यमराज्ये समानम्॥
verses.tr: pumān puṃso'dhi tiṣṭha carmehi tatra hvayasva yatamā priyā te yāvantāvagre prathamaṃ sameyathustad vāṃ vayo yamarājye samānam
verses.en: Mount, male from male, the skin. Go thither: summon those whom thou lovest, one and all, to meet thee. Strong as ye were when first ye met each other, still-be your strength the same in Yama's kingdom.

verses.sa:
तावद् वां चक्षुस्तति वीर्याऽणि तावत् तेजस्ततिधा वाजिनानि ।
अग्निः शरीरं सचते यदैधोऽधा पक्वान्मिथुना सं भवाथः॥
verses.tr: tāvad vāṃ cakṣustati vīryā'ṇi tāvat tejastatidhā vājināni agniḥ śarīraṃ sacate yadaidho'dhā pakvānmithunā saṃ bhavāthaḥ
verses.en: So strong your sight, so many be your powers, o great your force, your energies so many. When fire attends the body as its fuel, then may ye gain full chargers, O ye couple.

verses.sa:
समस्मिंल्लोके समु देवयाने सं स्मा समेतं यमराज्येषु ।
पूतौ पवित्रैरुप तद्ध्वयेथां यद्यद् रेतो अधि वां संबभूव॥
verses.tr: samasmiṃlloke samu devayāne saṃ smā sametaṃ yamarājyeṣu pūtau pavitrairupa taddhvayethāṃ yadyad reto adhi vāṃ saṃbabhūva
verses.en: Together in this world, in God-ward pathway, together be ye in the realms of Yama. Invite, made pure with means of purifying, whatever seed of yours hath been developed.

verses.sa:
आपस्पुत्रासो अभि सं विशध्वमिमं जीवं जीवधन्याः समेत्य ।
तासां भजध्वममृतं यमाहुर्यमोदनं पचति वां जनित्री॥
verses.tr: āpasputrāso abhi saṃ viśadhvamimaṃ jīvaṃ jīvadhanyāḥ sametya tāsāṃ bhajadhvamamṛtaṃ yamāhuryamodanaṃ pacati vāṃ janitrī
verses.en: Do ye, O sons, unite you with the waters, meeting this living man, ye life-sustainers. Allot to them the Odana your mother is making ready, which they call immortal.

verses.sa:
यं वां पिता पचति यं च माता रिप्रान्निर्मुक्त्यै शमलाच्च वाचः ।
स ओदनः शतधारः स्वर्ग उभे व्याऽप नभसी महित्वा॥
verses.tr: yaṃ vāṃ pitā pacati yaṃ ca mātā riprānnirmuktyai śamalācca vācaḥ sa odanaḥ śatadhāraḥ svarga ubhe vyā'pa nabhasī mahitvā
verses.en: That which your mother and your sire, to banish sin and uncleanness from their lips, are cooking, That Odana with hundred streams, sky-reaching, hath in its might pervaded earth and heaven,

verses.sa:
उभे नभसी उभयांश्च लोकान् ये यज्वनामभिजिताः स्वर्गाः ।
तेषां ज्योतिष्मान् मधुमान् यो अग्रे तस्मिन् पुत्रैर्जरसि सं श्रयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: ubhe nabhasī ubhayāṃśca lokān ye yajvanāmabhijitāḥ svargāḥ teṣāṃ jyotiṣmān madhumān yo agre tasmin putrairjarasi saṃ śrayethām
verses.en: Live with your sons, when life on earth is ended, live in the sphere most rich in light and sweetness. In skies that have been won by sacrifices make both the worlds, earth, heaven, your habitation,

verses.sa:
प्राचींप्राचीं प्रदिशमा रभेथामेतं लोकं श्रद्दधानाः सचन्ते ।
यद् वां पक्वं परिविष्टमग्नौ तस्य गुप्तये दंपती सं श्रयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: prācīṃprācīṃ pradiśamā rabhethāmetaṃ lokaṃ śraddadhānāḥ sacante yad vāṃ pakvaṃ pariviṣṭamagnau tasya guptaye daṃpatī saṃ śrayethām
verses.en: Approach the eastern, yea, the eastern region: this is the sphere to which the faithful turn them, Your cooked oblation that in fire was offered, together, wife and husband, meet to guard it.

verses.sa:
दक्षिणां दिशमभि नक्षमाणौ पर्यावर्तेथामभि पात्रमेतत्।
तस्मिन् वां यमः पितृभिः संविदानः पक्वाय शर्म बहुलं नि यच्छात्॥
verses.tr: dakṣiṇāṃ diśamabhi nakṣamāṇau paryāvartethāmabhi pātrametat tasmin vāṃ yamaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ pakvāya śarma bahulaṃ ni yacchāt
verses.en: Now, as your steps approach the southern quarter, move in your circling course about this vessel. Herein, accordant with the Fathers, Yama shall mightily protect your cooked oblation.

verses.sa:
प्रतीची दिशामियमिद् वरं यस्यां सोमो अधिपा मृडिता च ।
तस्यां श्रयेथां सुकृतः सचेथामधा पक्वान्मिथुना सं भवाथः॥
verses.tr: pratīcī diśāmiyamid varaṃ yasyāṃ somo adhipā mṛḍitā ca tasyāṃ śrayethāṃ sukṛtaḥ sacethāmadhā pakvānmithunā saṃ bhavāthaḥ
verses.en: Best of the regions is indeed this western wherein the King and gracious Lord is Soma. Thither resort for rest, follow the pious, Then gain the laden chargers, O ye couple.

verses.sa:
उत्तरं राष्ट्रं प्रजयोत्तरावद् दिशामुदीची कृणवन्नो अग्रम्।
पाङ्क्तं छन्दःपुरुषो बभूव विश्वैर्विश्वाङ्गैः सह सं भवेम॥
verses.tr: uttaraṃ rāṣṭraṃ prajayottarāvad diśāmudīcī kṛṇavanno agram pāṅktaṃ chandaḥpuruṣo babhūva viśvairviśvāṅgaiḥ saha saṃ bhavema
verses.en: Ever victorious is the northern region: may the east quarter set us first and foremost. The Man became the five-divisioned metre, May we abide with all our members perfect,

verses.sa:
ध्रुवेयं विराण्नमो अस्त्वस्यै शिवा पुत्रेभ्य उत मह्यमस्तु ।
सा नो देव्यदिते विश्ववार इर्य इव गोपा अभि रक्ष पक्वम्॥
verses.tr: dhruveyaṃ virāṇnamo astvasyai śivā putrebhya uta mahyamastu sā no devyadite viśvavāra irya iva gopā abhi rakṣa pakvam
verses.en: This stedfast realm is Queen. To her be homage! To me and to my sons may she be gracious. Guard thou, O Goddess Aditi, all-bounteous, our cooked oblation as an active warder,

verses.sa:
पितेव पुत्रानभि सं स्वजस्व नः शिवा नो वाता इव वान्तु भूमौ ।
यमोदनं पचतो देवते इह तं नस्तप उत सत्यं च वेत्तु॥
verses.tr: piteva putrānabhi saṃ svajasva naḥ śivā no vātā iva vāntu bhūmau yamodanaṃ pacato devate iha taṃ nastapa uta satyaṃ ca vettu
verses.en: Embrace us as a father clasps his children. Here on the Earth let kindly breezes fan us, Let the rice-mess these two cook here, O Goddess, know this our truthfulness and zealous fervour.

verses.sa:
यद्यत् कृष्णः शकुन एह गत्वा त्सरन् विषक्तं बिल आससाद ।
यद् वा दास्या३र्द्रहस्ता समङ्क्त उलूखलं मुसलं शुम्भतापः॥
verses.tr: yadyat kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna eha gatvā tsaran viṣaktaṃ bila āsasāda yad vā dāsyā3rdrahastā samaṅkta ulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ śumbhatāpaḥ
verses.en: If the dark bird hath come to us and, stealing the hanging morsel, settled in his dwelling, Or if the slave-girl hath, wet-handed, smearing the pestle and the mortar, cleansed the waters,

verses.sa:
अयं ग्रावा पृथुबुध्नो वयोधाः पूतः पवित्रैरप हन्तु रक्षः ।
आ रोह चर्म महि शर्म यच्छ मा दंपती पौत्रमघं नि गाताम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ grāvā pṛthubudhno vayodhāḥ pūtaḥ pavitrairapa hantu rakṣaḥ ā roha carma mahi śarma yaccha mā daṃpatī pautramaghaṃ ni gātām
verses.en: This pressing-stone, broad-based and strength-bestowing, made pure by cleansing means, shall chase the demon. Mount on the skin: afford us great protection, Let not the sons' sin fall on wife and husband.

verses.sa:
वनस्पतिः सह देवैर्न आगन् रक्षः पिशाचाँ अपबाधमानः ।
स उच्छ्रयातै प्र वदाति वाचं तेन लोकाँ अभि सर्वान् जयेम॥
verses.tr: vanaspatiḥ saha devairna āgan rakṣaḥ piśācāṃ apabādhamānaḥ sa ucchrayātai pra vadāti vācaṃ tena lokāṃ abhi sarvān jayema
verses.en: Together with the Gods, banning Pisachas and demons, hath Vanaspati come hither. He shall rise up and send his voice out loudly, May 'we win all the worlds with him to help us.

verses.sa:
सप्त मेधान् पशवः पर्यगृह्णन् य एषां ज्योतिष्मां उत यश्चकर्श ।
त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवतास्तान्त्सचन्ते स नः स्वर्गमभि नेष लोकम्॥
verses.tr: sapta medhān paśavaḥ paryagṛhṇan ya eṣāṃ jyotiṣmāṃ uta yaścakarśa trayastriṃśad devatāstāntsacante sa naḥ svargamabhi neṣa lokam
verses.en: Seven victims held the sacrificial essence, the bright one and the one that hath grown feeble. The three-and-thirty Deities attend them. As such, conduct us to the world of Svarga.

verses.sa:
स्वर्गं लोकमभि नो नयासि सं जायया सह पुत्रैः स्याम ।
गृह्णामि हस्तमनु मैत्वत्र मा नस्तारीन्निरृतिर्मो अरातिः॥
verses.tr: svargaṃ lokamabhi no nayāsi saṃ jāyayā saha putraiḥ syāma gṛhṇāmi hastamanu maitvatra mā nastārīnnirṛtirmo arātiḥ
verses.en: Unto the world of Svarga shalt thou lead us: there may we dwell beside our wife and children. I take thy hand. Let not Destruction, let not Malignity come hither and subdue us.

verses.sa:
ग्राहिं पाप्मानमति तां अयाम तमो व्यऽस्य प्र वदासि वल्गु।
वानस्पत्य उद्यतो मा जिहिंसीर्मा तण्डुलं वि शरीर्देवयन्तम्॥
verses.tr: grāhiṃ pāpmānamati tāṃ ayāma tamo vya'sya pra vadāsi valgu vānaspatya udyato mā jihiṃsīrmā taṇḍulaṃ vi śarīrdevayantam
verses.en: We have subdued that. sinful-hearted Grahi. Thou shalt speak sweetly having chased the darkness, Let not the wooden gear made ready fail us, nor harm the grain of rice that pays due worship,

verses.sa:
विश्वव्यचा घृतपृष्ठो भविष्यन्त्सयोनिर्लोकमुप याह्येतम्।
वर्षवृद्धमुप यच्छ शूर्पं तुषं पलावानप तद् विनक्तु॥
verses.tr: viśvavyacā ghṛtapṛṣṭho bhaviṣyantsayonirlokamupa yāhyetam varṣavṛddhamupa yaccha śūrpaṃ tuṣaṃ palāvānapa tad vinaktu
verses.en: Soon to be, decked with butter, all-embracing, come to this world wherewith birth unites thee. Seize thou the winnowing-fan which rains have nourished, and let this separate the chaff and refuse,

verses.sa:
त्रयो लोकाः संमिता ब्राह्मणेन द्यौरेवासौ पृथिव्य१न्तरिक्षम्।
अंशून् गृभीत्वान्वारभेथामा प्यायन्तां पुनरा यन्तु शूर्पम्॥
verses.tr: trayo lokāḥ saṃmitā brāhmaṇena dyaurevāsau pṛthivya1ntarikṣam aṃśūn gṛbhītvānvārabhethāmā pyāyantāṃ punarā yantu śūrpam
verses.en: Three worlds hath Power Divine marked out and measured, heaven yonder, and the earth, aud airs mid-region. Grasp ye the stalks and in your hands retain them: let them be watered and again be winnowed.

verses.sa:
पृथग् रूपाणि बहुधा पशूनामेकरूपो भवसि सं समृद्ध्या ।
एतां त्वचं लोहिनीं तां नुदस्व ग्रावा शुम्भाति मलग इव वस्त्रा॥
verses.tr: pṛthag rūpāṇi bahudhā paśūnāmekarūpo bhavasi saṃ samṛddhyā etāṃ tvacaṃ lohinīṃ tāṃ nudasva grāvā śumbhāti malaga iva vastrā
verses.en: Manifold, various are the shapes of victims. Thou growest uniform by great abundance, Push thou away this skin of ruddy colour: the stone will cleanse as one who cleanses raiment.

verses.sa:
पृथिवीं त्वा पृथिव्यामा वेशयामि तनूः समानी विकृता त एषा।
यद्यद् द्युत्तं लिखितमर्पणेन तेन मा सुस्रोर्ब्रह्मणापि तद् वपामि॥
verses.tr: pṛthivīṃ tvā pṛthivyāmā veśayāmi tanūḥ samānī vikṛtā ta eṣā yadyad dyuttaṃ likhitamarpaṇena tena mā susrorbrahmaṇāpi tad vapāmi
verses.en: Earth upon earth I set thee, This thy body is con-substantial, but in form it differs. Whate'er hath been worn off or scratched in fixing, leak not thereat: I spread a charm to mend it.

verses.sa:
जनित्रीव प्रति हर्यासि सूनुं सं त्वा दधामि पृथिवीं पृथिव्या।
उखा कुम्भी वेद्यां मा व्यथिष्ठा यज्ञायुधैराज्येनातिषक्ता॥
verses.tr: janitrīva prati haryāsi sūnuṃ saṃ tvā dadhāmi pṛthivīṃ pṛthivyā ukhā kumbhī vedyāṃ mā vyathiṣṭhā yajñāyudhairājyenātiṣaktā
verses.en: Thou for thy son shalt yearn as yearns a mother. I lay thee down and with the earth unite thee, Conjoined with sacrificial gear and butter may pot and jar stand firmly on the altar,

verses.sa:
अग्निः पचन् रक्षतु त्वा पुरस्तादिन्द्रो रक्षतु दक्षिणतो मरुत्वान्।
वरुणस्त्वा दृंहाद्धरुणे प्रतीच्या उत्तरात् त्वा सोमः सं ददातै॥
verses.tr: agniḥ pacan rakṣatu tvā purastādindro rakṣatu dakṣiṇato marutvān varuṇastvā dṛṃhāddharuṇe pratīcyā uttarāt tvā somaḥ saṃ dadātai
verses.en: Eastward may Agni as he cooks preserve thee, Southward may Indra, grit by Maruts, guard thee, Varuna strengthen aud support thee weastward, and Sowa on the north hold thee together,

verses.sa:
पूताः पवित्रैः पवन्ते अभ्राद् दिवं च यन्ति पृथिवीं च लोकान्।
ता जीवला जीवधन्याः प्रतिष्ठाः पात्र आसिक्ताः पर्यग्निरिन्धाम्॥
verses.tr: pūtāḥ pavitraiḥ pavante abhrād divaṃ ca yanti pṛthivīṃ ca lokān tā jīvalā jīvadhanyāḥ pratiṣṭhāḥ pātra āsiktāḥ paryagnirindhām
verses.en: Drops flow, made pure by filters, from the rain-cloud: to heaven and earth and to the worlds they travel. May Indra light them up, poured in the vessel, lively and stedfast, quickening living creatures.

verses.sa:
आ यन्ति दिवः पृथिवीं सचन्ते भूम्याः सचन्ते अध्यन्तरिक्षम्।
शुद्धाः सतीस्ता उ शुम्भन्त एव ता नः स्वर्गमभि लोकं नयन्तु॥
verses.tr: ā yanti divaḥ pṛthivīṃ sacante bhūmyāḥ sacante adhyantarikṣam śuddhāḥ satīstā u śumbhanta eva tā naḥ svargamabhi lokaṃ nayantu
verses.en: From heaven they come, they visit earth, and rising from earth unite themselves with air's mid-region. Purified, excellent, they shine in beauty. Thus may they lead us to the world of Svarga.

verses.sa:
उतेव प्रभ्वीरुत संमितास उत शुक्राः शुचयश्चामृतासः ।
ता ओदनं दंपतिभ्यां प्रशिष्टा आपः शिक्षन्तीः पचता सुनाथाः॥
verses.tr: uteva prabhvīruta saṃmitāsa uta śukrāḥ śucayaścāmṛtāsaḥ tā odanaṃ daṃpatibhyāṃ praśiṣṭā āpaḥ śikṣantīḥ pacatā sunāthāḥ
verses.en: Yea, and supreme, alike in conformation, and brilliant and refulgent and immortal, As such, enjoined, well-guarding, water-givers, dress ye the Odana for wife aud husband,

verses.sa:
संख्याता स्तोकाः पृथिवीं सचन्ते प्राणापानैः संमिता ओषधीभिः ।
असंख्याता ओप्यमानाः सुवर्णाः सर्वं व्याऽपुः शुचयः शुचित्वम्॥
verses.tr: saṃkhyātā stokāḥ pṛthivīṃ sacante prāṇāpānaiḥ saṃmitā oṣadhībhiḥ asaṃkhyātā opyamānāḥ suvarṇāḥ sarvaṃ vyā'puḥ śucayaḥ śucitvam
verses.en: Numbered, they visit earth, these drops of moisture, commensurate with plants and vital breathings. Unnumbered. scattered, beautiful in colour, the bright ones have pervaded all refulgence, l

verses.sa:
उद्योधन्त्यभि वल्गन्ति तप्ताः फेनमस्यन्ति बहुलांश्च बिन्दून्।
योषेव दृष्ट्वा पतिमृत्वियायैतैस्तण्डुलैर्भवता समापः॥
verses.tr: udyodhantyabhi valganti taptāḥ phenamasyanti bahulāṃśca bindūn yoṣeva dṛṣṭvā patimṛtviyāyaitaistaṇḍulairbhavatā samāpaḥ
verses.en: Heated, they rege and boil in agitation, they cast about their foam and countless bubbles-Like a fond woman when she sees her husband—what time ye waters and these rice-grains mingle,

verses.sa:
उत्थापय सीदतो बुध्न एनानद्भिरात्मानमभि सं स्पृशन्ताम्।
अमासि पात्रैरुदकं यदेतन्मितास्तण्डुलाः प्रदिशो यदीमाः॥
verses.tr: utthāpaya sīdato budhna enānadbhirātmānamabhi saṃ spṛśantām amāsi pātrairudakaṃ yadetanmitāstaṇḍulāḥ pradiśo yadīmāḥ
verses.en: Take up these rice-grains lying at the bottom: led them be blent and mingled with the waters. This water I have measured in the vessel, if as mid-points the rice-grains have been meted.

verses.sa:
प्र यच्छ पर्शुं त्वरया हरौसमहिंसन्त ओषधीर्दान्तु पर्वन्।
यासां सोमः परि राज्यं बभूवामन्युता नो वीरुधो भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: pra yaccha parśuṃ tvarayā harausamahiṃsanta oṣadhīrdāntu parvan yāsāṃ somaḥ pari rājyaṃ babhūvāmanyutā no vīrudho bhavantu
verses.en: Present the sickle: quickly bring it hither. "Let them cut plants and joints with hands that harm not. So may the plants be free from wrath against us, they o'er whose realm Soma hath won dominion,

verses.sa:
नवं बर्हिरोदनाय स्तृणीत प्रियं हृदश्चक्षुषो वल्ग्वऽस्तु ।
तस्मिन् देवाः सह दैवीर्विशन्त्विमं प्राश्नन्त्वृतुभिर्निषद्य॥
verses.tr: navaṃ barhirodanāya stṛṇīta priyaṃ hṛdaścakṣuṣo valgva'stu tasmin devāḥ saha daivīrviśantvimaṃ prāśnantvṛtubhirniṣadya
verses.en: Strew ye fresh grass for the boiled rice to rest on: fair let it be, sweet to the eye and spirit. Hither come Goddesses with Gods, and sitting here taste in proper season this oblation!

verses.sa:
वनस्पते स्तीर्णमा सीद बर्हिरग्निष्टोभैः संमितो देवताभिः ।
त्वष्ट्रेव रूपं सुकृतं स्वधित्यैना एहाः परि पात्रे ददृश्राम्॥
verses.tr: vanaspate stīrṇamā sīda barhiragniṣṭobhaiḥ saṃmito devatābhiḥ tvaṣṭreva rūpaṃ sukṛtaṃ svadhityainā ehāḥ pari pātre dadṛśrām
verses.en: On the strewn grass, Vanaspati, be seated; commensurate with Gods and Agnishtomas, 'Let thy fair form, wrought as by Tvashtar's hatchet, mark these that yearn for thee within the vessel.

verses.sa:
षष्ट्यां शरत्सु निधिपा अभीच्छात् स्वःऽ पक्वेनाभ्यश्नवातै ।
उपैनं जीवान् पितरश्च पुत्रा एतं स्वर्गं गमयान्तमग्नेः॥
verses.tr: ṣaṣṭyāṃ śaratsu nidhipā abhīcchāt svaḥ' pakvenābhyaśnavātai upainaṃ jīvān pitaraśca putrā etaṃ svargaṃ gamayāntamagneḥ
verses.en: In sixty autumns may the Treasure—Guardian seek to gain heavenly light by cooked oblation, On this may sons and fathers live dependent. Send thou this mess to Fire that leads to heaven,

verses.sa:
धर्ता ध्रियस्व धरुणे पृथिव्या अच्युतं त्वा देवताश्च्यावयन्तु ।
तं त्वा दंपती जीवन्तौ जीवपुत्रावुद् वासयातः पर्यग्निधानात्॥
verses.tr: dhartā dhriyasva dharuṇe pṛthivyā acyutaṃ tvā devatāścyāvayantu taṃ tvā daṃpatī jīvantau jīvaputrāvud vāsayātaḥ paryagnidhānāt
verses.en: On the earth's breast stand firmly as supporter: may Deities stir thee who ne'er hast shaken. So living man and wife with living children remove thee from the hearth of circling Agni.

verses.sa:
सर्वान्त्समागा अभिजित्य लोकान् यावन्तः कामाः समतीतृपस्तान्।
वि गाहेथामायवनं च दर्विरेकस्मिन् पात्रे अध्युद्धरैनम्॥
verses.tr: sarvāntsamāgā abhijitya lokān yāvantaḥ kāmāḥ samatītṛpastān vi gāhethāmāyavanaṃ ca darvirekasmin pātre adhyuddharainam
verses.en: All wishes that have blessed those with fulfilment, having won all the worlds have met together. Let them plunge in both stirring-spoon and ladle: raise this and set it in a single vessel.

verses.sa:
उप स्तृणीहि प्रथय पुरस्ताद् घृतेन पात्रमभि घारयैतत्।
वाश्रेवोस्रा तरुणं स्तनस्युमिमं देवासो अभिहिङ्कृणोत॥
verses.tr: upa stṛṇīhi prathaya purastād ghṛtena pātramabhi ghārayaitat vāśrevosrā taruṇaṃ stanasyumimaṃ devāso abhihiṅkṛṇota
verses.en: Pour out the covering butter, spread it eastward: sprinkle this vessel over with the fatness, Greet this, ye Deities, with gentle murmur, as lowing cows welcome their tender suckling,

verses.sa:
उपास्तरीरकरो लोकमेतमुरुः प्रथतामसमः स्वर्गः ।
तस्मिंछ्रयातै महिषः सुपर्णो देवा एनं देवताभ्यः प्रच्यछान्॥
verses.tr: upāstarīrakaro lokametamuruḥ prathatāmasamaḥ svargaḥ tasmiṃchrayātai mahiṣaḥ suparṇo devā enaṃ devatābhyaḥ pracyachān
verses.en: Thou hast poured oil and made the worlds: let heaven, unequalled, be spread out in wide extension. 'Herein be cooked the buffalo, strong-pinioned: the Gods shall give the Deities this oblation.

verses.sa:
यद्यज्जाया पचति त्वत् परःपरः पतिर्वा जाये त्वत् तिरः ।
सं तत् सृजेथां सह वां तदस्तु संपादयन्तौ सह लोमेकम्॥
verses.tr: yadyajjāyā pacati tvat paraḥparaḥ patirvā jāye tvat tiraḥ saṃ tat sṛjethāṃ saha vāṃ tadastu saṃpādayantau saha lomekam
verses.en: Whate'er thy wife, away from thee makes ready, or what, O wife, apart from thee, thy husband, Combine it all: let it be yours in common while ye produce one world with joint endeavour.

verses.sa:
यावन्तो अस्याः पृथिवीं सचन्ते अस्मत् पुत्राः परि ये संबभूवुः ।
सर्वांस्तां उप पात्रे ह्वयेथां नाभिं जानानाः शिशवः समायान्॥
verses.tr: yāvanto asyāḥ pṛthivīṃ sacante asmat putrāḥ pari ye saṃbabhūvuḥ sarvāṃstāṃ upa pātre hvayethāṃ nābhiṃ jānānāḥ śiśavaḥ samāyān
verses.en: All these now dwelling on the earth, mine offspring, these whom this woman here, my wife, hath borne me, Invite them all unto the vessel: knowing their kinship have the children met together.

verses.sa:
वसोर्या धारा मधुना प्रपीना घृतेन मिश्रा अमृतस्य नाभयः ।
सर्वास्ता अव रुन्धे स्वर्गः षष्ट्यां शरत्सु निधिपा अभीच्छात्॥
verses.tr: vasoryā dhārā madhunā prapīnā ghṛtena miśrā amṛtasya nābhayaḥ sarvāstā ava rundhe svargaḥ ṣaṣṭyāṃ śaratsu nidhipā abhīcchāt
verses.en: Swollen with savoury meath, the stream of treasures, sourses of immortality blent with fatness—, Soma retains all these: in sixty autumns the Guardian Lord of Treasures may desire them.

verses.sa:
निधिं निधिपा अभ्येऽनमिच्छादनीश्वरा अभितः सन्तु ये३न्ये।
अस्माभिर्दत्तो निहितः स्वर्गस्त्रिभिः काण्डैस्त्रीन्त्स्वर्गानरुक्षत्॥
verses.tr: nidhiṃ nidhipā abhye'namicchādanīśvarā abhitaḥ santu ye3nye asmābhirdatto nihitaḥ svargastribhiḥ kāṇḍaistrīntsvargānarukṣat
verses.en: The Lord of Treasures may desire this treasure: lordless on every side be all the others. Our mess, presented, seeking heaven, hath mounted in three divisions all three realms of Svarga.

verses.sa:
अग्नी रक्षस्तपतु यद् विदेवं क्रव्याद् पिशाच इह मा प्र पास्त ।
नुदाम एनमप रुध्मो अस्मदादित्या एनमङ्गिरसः सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: agnī rakṣastapatu yad videvaṃ kravyād piśāca iha mā pra pāsta nudāma enamapa rudhmo asmadādityā enamaṅgirasaḥ sacantām
verses.en: May Agni burn the God-denying demon: let no carnivorous Pisacha drink here. We drive him off, we keep him at a distance, Adityas and Angirases pursue him!

verses.sa:
आदित्येभ्यो अङ्गिरोभ्यो मध्विदं घृतेन मिश्रं प्रति वेदयामि ।
शुद्धहस्तौ ब्राह्मणस्यानिहत्यैतं स्वर्गं सुकृतावपीतम्॥
verses.tr: ādityebhyo aṅgirobhyo madhvidaṃ ghṛtena miśraṃ prati vedayāmi śuddhahastau brāhmaṇasyānihatyaitaṃ svargaṃ sukṛtāvapītam
verses.en: This meath do I announce, mingled with butter, to the Angirases and the Adityas, With pure hands ne'er laid roughly on a Brahman go, pious couple, to the world of Svarga.

verses.sa:
इदं प्रापमुत्तमं काण्डमस्य यस्माल्लोकात् परमेष्ठी समाप ।
आ सिञ्च सर्पिर्घृतवत् समङ्ग्ध्येष भागो अङ्गिरसो नो अत्र॥
verses.tr: idaṃ prāpamuttamaṃ kāṇḍamasya yasmāllokāt parameṣṭhī samāpa ā siñca sarpirghṛtavat samaṅgdhyeṣa bhāgo aṅgiraso no atra
verses.en: Of this have I obtained the noblest portion from that same world whence Parameshthin gained it. Pour forth, besprinkle butter rich in fatness: the share of Angiras is here before us. i:

verses.sa:
सत्याय च तपसे देवताभ्यो निधिं शेवधिं परि दद्म एतम्।
मा नो द्यूतेऽव गान्मा समित्यां मा स्मान्यस्मा उत् सृजता पुरा मत्॥
verses.tr: satyāya ca tapase devatābhyo nidhiṃ śevadhiṃ pari dadma etam mā no dyūte'va gānmā samityāṃ mā smānyasmā ut sṛjatā purā mat
verses.en: To Deities, to Truth, to holy Fervour this tresure we consign, this rich deposit, At play, in meeting let it not desert us, never give out to anyone besides me,

verses.sa:
अहं पचाम्यहं ददामि ममेदु कर्मन्करुणेऽधि जाया।
कौमारो लोको अजनिष्ट पुत्रो३न्वारभेथां वय उत्तरावत्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ pacāmyahaṃ dadāmi mamedu karmankaruṇe'dhi jāyā kaumāro loko ajaniṣṭa putro3nvārabhethāṃ vaya uttarāvat
verses.en: I cook the offering, I present oblatiou: only my wife attends the holy service. A. youthful world, a son hath been begotten, Begin a life that brings success and triumph,

verses.sa:
न किल्बिषमत्र नाधारो अस्ति न यन्मित्रैः समममान एति ।
अनूनं पात्रं निहितं न एतत् पक्तारं पक्वः पुनरा विशाति॥
verses.tr: na kilbiṣamatra nādhāro asti na yanmitraiḥ samamamāna eti anūnaṃ pātraṃ nihitaṃ na etat paktāraṃ pakvaḥ punarā viśāti
verses.en: There is no fault in this, no reservation, none when it goes with friends in close alliance. We have laid down this vessel in perfection: the cooked mess shall re-enter him who cooked it.

verses.sa:
प्रियं प्रियाणां कृणवाम तमस्ते यन्तु यतमे द्विषन्ति ।
धेनुरनड्वान् वयोवय आयदेव पौरुषेयमप मृत्युं नुदन्तु॥
verses.tr: priyaṃ priyāṇāṃ kṛṇavāma tamaste yantu yatame dviṣanti dhenuranaḍvān vayovaya āyadeva pauruṣeyamapa mṛtyuṃ nudantu
verses.en: To those we love may we do acts that please them, Away to darkness go all those who hate us! Cow, ox, and strenght of every kind approach us! Thus let them banish death of human beings,

verses.sa:
समग्नयो विदुरन्यो अन्यं य ओषधीः सचते यश्च सिन्धून्।
यावन्तो देवा दिव्या३तपन्ति हिरण्यं ज्योतिः पचतो बभूव॥
verses.tr: samagnayo viduranyo anyaṃ ya oṣadhīḥ sacate yaśca sindhūn yāvanto devā divyā3tapanti hiraṇyaṃ jyotiḥ pacato babhūva
verses.en: Perfectly do the Agnis know each other, one visitor of plants and one of rivers, And all the Gods who shine and glow in heaven. Gold is the light of him who cooks oblation,

verses.sa:
एषा त्वचां पुरुषे सं बभूवानग्नाः सर्वे पशवो ये अन्ये।
क्षत्रेणात्मानं परि धापयाथोऽमोतं वासो मुखमोदनस्य॥
verses.tr: eṣā tvacāṃ puruṣe saṃ babhūvānagnāḥ sarve paśavo ye anye kṣatreṇātmānaṃ pari dhāpayātho'motaṃ vāso mukhamodanasya
verses.en: Man hath received this skin of his from nature: of other animals not one is naked, Ye make him clothe himself with might for raiment, Odana's mouth is a home-woven vesture.

verses.sa:
यदक्षेषु वदा यत् समित्यां यद् वा वदा अनृतं वित्तकाम्या।
समानं तन्तुमभि संवसानौ तस्मिन्त्सर्वं शमलं सादयाथः॥
verses.tr: yadakṣeṣu vadā yat samityāṃ yad vā vadā anṛtaṃ vittakāmyā samānaṃ tantumabhi saṃvasānau tasmintsarvaṃ śamalaṃ sādayāthaḥ
verses.en: Whatever thou may say at dice, in meeting, whatever falsehood through desire of riches, Ye two, about one common warp uniting, deposit all impurity within it, i

verses.sa:
वर्षं वनुष्वापि गच्छ देवांस्त्वचो धूमं पर्युत् पातयासि ।
विश्वव्यचा घृतपृष्ठो भविष्यन्त्सयोनिर्लोकमुप याह्येतम्॥
verses.tr: varṣaṃ vanuṣvāpi gaccha devāṃstvaco dhūmaṃ paryut pātayāsi viśvavyacā ghṛtapṛṣṭho bhaviṣyantsayonirlokamupa yāhyetam
verses.en: Win thou the rain: approach the Gods. Around thee thou from the skin shalt make the smoke rise upward. Soon to be, decked with butter, all-embracing, come to this world wherewith one birth unites thee.

verses.sa:
तन्वं स्वर्गो बहुधा वि चक्रे यथा विद आत्मन्नन्यवर्णाम्।
अपाजैत् कृष्णां रुशतीं पुनानो या लोहिनी तां ते अग्नौ जुहोमि॥
verses.tr: tanvaṃ svargo bahudhā vi cakre yathā vida ātmannanyavarṇām apājait kṛṣṇāṃ ruśatīṃ punāno yā lohinī tāṃ te agnau juhomi
verses.en: In many a shape hath heaven transformed its body, as in itself is known, of varied colour. Cleansing the bright, the dark form hath it banished: the red form in the fire to thee I offer.

verses.sa:
प्राच्यै त्वा दिशे३ग्नयेऽधिपतयेऽसिताय रक्षित्र आदित्यायेषुमते ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम॥
verses.tr: prācyai tvā diśe3gnaye'dhipataye'sitāya rakṣitra ādityāyeṣumate etaṃ pari dadmastaṃ no gopāyatāsmākamaitoḥ diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣajjarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātvatha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema
verses.en: To the eastern region, to Agnithe Regent, to Asita As the Protector, Aditya the Archer, we present thee, this offering of ours. Do ye preserve it from aggression. To full old age may Destiny conduct us; may full old age deliver us to Mrityu. Then may we be with our prepared oblation,

verses.sa:
दक्षिणायै त्वा दिश इन्द्रायाधिपतये तिरश्चिराजये रक्षित्रे यमायेषुमते ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम॥
verses.tr: dakṣiṇāyai tvā diśa indrāyādhipataye tiraścirājaye rakṣitre yamāyeṣumate etaṃ pari dadmastaṃ no gopāyatāsmākamaitoḥ diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣajjarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātvatha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema
verses.en: To the southern region, to Indra the Regent, to Tiraschiraji the Protector, to Yama the Archer, we present, etc. (as in stanza 55).

verses.sa:
प्रतीच्यै त्वा दिशे वरुणायाधिपतये पृदाकवे रक्षित्रेऽन्नायेषुमते ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम॥
verses.tr: pratīcyai tvā diśe varuṇāyādhipataye pṛdākave rakṣitre'nnāyeṣumate etaṃ pari dadmastaṃ no gopāyatāsmākamaitoḥ diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣajjarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātvatha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema
verses.en: To the western region, to Varuna the Regent, to Pridaku the Protector, to Food the Archer, we present, etc,

verses.sa:
उदीच्यै त्वा दिशे सोमायाधिपतये स्वजाय रक्षित्रेऽशन्या इषुमत्यै ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम॥
verses.tr: udīcyai tvā diśe somāyādhipataye svajāya rakṣitre'śanyā iṣumatyai etaṃ pari dadmastaṃ no gopāyatāsmākamaitoḥ diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣajjarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātvatha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema
verses.en: To the northern region; to Soma the Regent, to Svaja the Protector, to Thuderbolt the Archer, we present, etc,

verses.sa:
ध्रुवायै त्वा दिशे विष्णवेऽधिपतये कल्माषग्रीवाय रक्षित्र ओषधीभ्य इषुमतीभ्यः ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम॥
verses.tr: dhruvāyai tvā diśe viṣṇave'dhipataye kalmāṣagrīvāya rakṣitra oṣadhībhya iṣumatībhyaḥ etaṃ pari dadmastaṃ no gopāyatāsmākamaitoḥ diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣajjarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātvatha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema
verses.en: To the stedfast region, to Vishnu the Regent, to ' Kalmashagriva the Protector, to Plants the Archers, we present, etc.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वायै त्वा दिशे बृहस्पतयेऽधिपतये श्वित्राय रक्षित्रे वर्षायेषुमते ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvāyai tvā diśe bṛhaspataye'dhipataye śvitrāya rakṣitre varṣāyeṣumate etaṃ pari dadmastaṃ no gopāyatāsmākamaitoḥ diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣajjarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātvatha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema
verses.en: To the upper region, to Brihaspati the Regent, to Svitra the Protector, to Rain the Archer, we present thee, this offering of onrs, Do ye preserve it from aggression, "To full old age may Destiny conduct us, may full old age deliver us to Mrityu. Then may we be with our prepared oblation,

sections.label: On the duty of giving cows to Brahmans
sections.name: Book 12, hymn 4

verses.sa:
ददामीत्येव ब्रूयादनु चैनामभुत्सत ।
वशां ब्रह्मभ्यो याचद्भ्यस्तत् प्रजावदपत्यवत्॥
verses.tr: dadāmītyeva brūyādanu caināmabhutsata vaśāṃ brahmabhyo yācadbhyastat prajāvadapatyavat
verses.en: I Give the gift, shall be his word: and straightway they have bound the Cow E For Brahman priests who beg the boon, That bringeth sons and progeny.

verses.sa:
प्रजया स वि क्रीणीते पशुभिश्चोप दस्यति ।
य आर्षेयेभ्यो याचद्भ्यो देवानां गां न दित्सति॥
verses.tr: prajayā sa vi krīṇīte paśubhiścopa dasyati ya ārṣeyebhyo yācadbhyo devānāṃ gāṃ na ditsati
verses.en: He trades and traffics with his sons, and in his cattle suffers loss. Mp. Who will not give the Cow of Gods to Rishis' children when they beg.

verses.sa:
कूटयास्य सं शीर्यन्ते श्लोणया काटमर्दति ।
बण्डया दह्यन्ते गृहाः काणया दीयते स्वम्॥
verses.tr: kūṭayāsya saṃ śīryante śloṇayā kāṭamardati baṇḍayā dahyante gṛhāḥ kāṇayā dīyate svam
verses.en: They perish through a "hornless cow, a lame cow sinks them in a pit. Through a maimed cow his house is burnt: a one-eyed cow destroys his wealth.

verses.sa:
विलोहितो अधिष्ठानाच्छक्नो विन्दति गोपतिम्।
तथा वशायाः संविद्यं दुरदभ्ना ह्यु१च्यसे॥
verses.tr: vilohito adhiṣṭhānācchakno vindati gopatim tathā vaśāyāḥ saṃvidyaṃ duradabhnā hyu1cyase
verses.en: Fierce fever where her droppings fall attacks the master of the kine, ] So have they named her Vasa, for thou art called uncontrollable, f

verses.sa:
पदोरस्या अधिष्ठानाद् विक्लिन्दुर्नाम विन्दति ।
अनामनात् सं शीर्यन्ते या मुखेनोपजिघ्रति॥
verses.tr: padorasyā adhiṣṭhānād viklindurnāma vindati anāmanāt saṃ śīryante yā mukhenopajighrati
verses.en: The malady Vikliadu springs on him from ground whereon she stands, And suddenly, from fell disease, perish the men on whom she sniffs,

verses.sa:
यो अस्याः कर्णावास्कुनोत्या स देवेषु वृश्चते ।
लक्ष्म कुर्व इति मन्यते कनीयः कृणुते स्वम्॥
verses.tr: yo asyāḥ karṇāvāskunotyā sa deveṣu vṛścate lakṣma kurva iti manyate kanīyaḥ kṛṇute svam
verses.en: Whoever twitches up her ears is separated from the Gods, He deems he makes a mark, but he diminishes his wealth thereby,

verses.sa:
यदस्याः कस्मै चिद् भोगाय बालान् कश्चित् प्रकृन्तति ।
ततः किशोरा म्रियन्ते वत्सांश्च घातुको वृकः॥
verses.tr: yadasyāḥ kasmai cid bhogāya bālān kaścit prakṛntati tataḥ kiśorā mriyante vatsāṃśca ghātuko vṛkaḥ
verses.en: If to his own advantage one applies the long hair of her tail, His colts, in consequence thereof, die, and the wolf destroys his calves.
