verses.sa:
यदस्या गोपतौ सत्या लोम ध्वाङ्क्षो अजीहिडत्।
ततः कुमारा म्रियन्ते यक्ष्मो विन्दत्यनामनात्॥
verses.tr: yadasyā gopatau satyā loma dhvāṅkṣo ajīhiḍat tataḥ kumārā mriyante yakṣmo vindatyanāmanāt
verses.en: If, while her master owneth her, a carrion crow hath harmed her hair, His young boys die thereof, Decline overtakes them after fell disease.

verses.sa:
यदस्याः पल्पूलनं शकृद् दासी समस्यति ।
ततोऽपरूपं जायते तस्मादव्येष्यदेनसः॥
verses.tr: yadasyāḥ palpūlanaṃ śakṛd dāsī samasyati tato'parūpaṃ jāyate tasmādavyeṣyadenasaḥ
verses.en: What time the Dasi woman throws lye on the droppings of the Cow, Misshapen birth arises thence, inseparable from that sin.

verses.sa:
जायमानाभि जायते देवान्त्सब्राह्मणान् वशा।
तस्माद् ब्रह्मभ्यो देयैषा तदाहुः स्वस्य गोपनम्॥
verses.tr: jāyamānābhi jāyate devāntsabrāhmaṇān vaśā tasmād brahmabhyo deyaiṣā tadāhuḥ svasya gopanam
verses.en: For Gods and Brahmans is the Cow produced when first she springs to life, Hence to the priests must she be given: this they call guarding private wealth.

verses.sa:
य एनां वनिमायन्ति तेषां देवकृता वशा।
ब्रह्मज्येयं तदब्रुवन् य एनां निप्रियायते॥
verses.tr: ya enāṃ vanimāyanti teṣāṃ devakṛtā vaśā brahmajyeyaṃ tadabruvan ya enāṃ nipriyāyate
verses.en: The God-created Cow belongs to those who come to ask for her, They call it outrage on the priests when one retains her as his own.

verses.sa:
य आर्षेयेभ्यो याचद्भ्यो देवानां गां न दित्सति ।
आ स देवेषु वृश्चते ब्राह्मणानां च मन्यवे॥
verses.tr: ya ārṣeyebhyo yācadbhyo devānāṃ gāṃ na ditsati ā sa deveṣu vṛścate brāhmaṇānāṃ ca manyave
verses.en: He who withholds the Cow of Gods from Rishis' sons who ask the gift Is made an alien to the Gods, and subject to the Brahmans' wrath.

verses.sa:
यो अस्य स्याद् वशाभोगो अन्यामिच्छेत तर्हि सः ।
हिंस्ते अदत्ता पुरुषं याचितां च न दित्सति॥
verses.tr: yo asya syād vaśābhogo anyāmiccheta tarhi saḥ hiṃste adattā puruṣaṃ yācitāṃ ca na ditsati
verses.en: Then let him seek another Cow, whate'er his profit be in this, The Cow, not given, harms a man when he denies her at their prayer.

verses.sa:
यथा शेवधिर्निहितो ब्राह्मणानां तथा वशा।
तामेतदच्छायन्ति यस्मिन् कस्मिंश्च जायते॥
verses.tr: yathā śevadhirnihito brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā vaśā tāmetadacchāyanti yasmin kasmiṃśca jāyate
verses.en: Like a rich treasure stored away in safety is the Brahmans' Cow. "Therefore men come to visit her, with whomsoever she is born.

verses.sa:
स्वमेतदच्छायन्ति यद् वशां ब्राह्मणा अभि।
यथैनानन्यस्मिन् जिनीयादेवास्या निरोधनम्॥
verses.tr: svametadacchāyanti yad vaśāṃ brāhmaṇā abhi yathainānanyasmin jinīyādevāsyā nirodhanam
verses.en: So when the Brahmans come unto the Cow they come unto their own, For this is her withholding, to oppress these in another life.

verses.sa:
चरेदेवा त्रैहायणा दविज्ञातगदा सती।
वशां च विद्यान्नारद ब्राह्मणास्तर्ह्येष्याः॥
verses.tr: caredevā traihāyaṇā davijñātagadā satī vaśāṃ ca vidyānnārada brāhmaṇāstarhyeṣyāḥ
verses.en: Thus after three years may she go, speaking what is not understood. He, Narada! would know the Cow, then Brahmans must be sought unto,

verses.sa:
य एनामवशामाह देवानां निहितं निधिम्।
उभौ तस्मै भवाशर्वौ परिक्रम्येषुमस्यतः॥
verses.tr: ya enāmavaśāmāha devānāṃ nihitaṃ nidhim ubhau tasmai bhavāśarvau parikramyeṣumasyataḥ
verses.en: Whoso calls her a worthless Cow, the stored-up treasure of the Gods, Bhava and Sarva, both of them, move round and shoot a shaft at him.

verses.sa:
यो अस्या ऊधो न वेदाथो अस्या स्तनानुत।
उभयेनैवास्मै दुहे दातुं चे दशकद् वशाम्॥
verses.tr: yo asyā ūdho na vedātho asyā stanānuta ubhayenaivāsmai duhe dātuṃ ce daśakad vaśām
verses.en: The man who hath no knowledge of her udder and the teats thereof, She yields him milk with these, if he hath purposed to bestow the Cow.

verses.sa:
दुरदभ्नैनमा शये याचितां च न दित्सति ।
नास्मै कामाः समृध्यन्ते यामदत्त्वा चिकीर्षति॥
verses.tr: duradabhnainamā śaye yācitāṃ ca na ditsati nāsmai kāmāḥ samṛdhyante yāmadattvā cikīrṣati
verses.en: If he withholds the Cow they beg, she lies rebellious in his stall. Vain are the wishes and the hopes which he, withholding her, would gain.

verses.sa:
देवा वशामयाचन् मुखं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणम्।
तेषां सर्वेषामददद्धेडं न्येऽति मानुषः॥
verses.tr: devā vaśāmayācan mukhaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇam teṣāṃ sarveṣāmadadaddheḍaṃ nye'ti mānuṣaḥ
verses.en: The Deities have begged the Cow, using the Brahman as their mouth: The man who gives her not incurs the enmity of all the Gods, i

verses.sa:
हेडं पशूनां न्येऽति ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽददद् वशाम्।
देवानां निहितं भागं मर्त्यश्चेन्निप्रियायते॥
verses.tr: heḍaṃ paśūnāṃ nye'ti brāhmaṇebhyo'dadad vaśām devānāṃ nihitaṃ bhāgaṃ martyaścennipriyāyate
verses.en: Withholding her from Brahmans, he incurs the anger of the beasts, When mortal man appropriates the destined: portion of the Gods,

verses.sa:
यदन्ये शतं याचेयुर्ब्राह्मणा गोपतिं वशाम्।
अथैनां देवा अब्रुवन्नेवं ह विदुषो वशा॥
verses.tr: yadanye śataṃ yāceyurbrāhmaṇā gopatiṃ vaśām athaināṃ devā abruvannevaṃ ha viduṣo vaśā
verses.en: If hundred other Brahmans beg the Cow of him who. owneth her; The Gods have said, She, verily, belongs to him who knows the truth,

verses.sa:
य एवं विदुषेऽदत्त्वाथान्येभ्यो ददद् वशाम्।
दुर्गा तस्मा अधिष्ठाने पृथिवी सहदेवता॥
verses.tr: ya evaṃ viduṣe'dattvāthānyebhyo dadad vaśām durgā tasmā adhiṣṭhāne pṛthivī sahadevatā
verses.en: Whoso to others, not to him who hath this knowledge, gives the Cow, Earth, with the Deities, is hard for him. to win and rest, upon,

verses.sa:
देवा वशामयाचन् यस्मिन्नग्रे अजायत ।
तामेतां विद्यान्नारदः सह देवैरुदाजत॥
verses.tr: devā vaśāmayācan yasminnagre ajāyata tāmetāṃ vidyānnāradaḥ saha devairudājata
verses.en: The Deities begged the Cow from him with whom at first she was produced: Her, this one, Narada would know: with Deities he drove her forth.

verses.sa:
अनपत्यमल्पपशुं वशा कृणोति पूरुषम्।
ब्राह्मणैश्च याचितामथैनां निप्रियायते॥
verses.tr: anapatyamalpapaśuṃ vaśā kṛṇoti pūruṣam brāhmaṇaiśca yācitāmathaināṃ nipriyāyate
verses.en: The Cow deprives of progeny and makes him poor in cattle who Retains in his possession her whom Brahmans have solicited. I8 The cow which the owner intends to bestow ona Brahman will give him milk without the trouble of milking her,

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमाभ्यां कामाय मित्राय वरुणाय च ।
तेभ्यो याचन्ति ब्राह्मणास्तेष्वा वृश्चतेऽददत्॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomābhyāṃ kāmāya mitrāya varuṇāya ca tebhyo yācanti brāhmaṇāsteṣvā vṛścate'dadat
verses.en: For Agni and for Soma, for Kama, Mitra and Varuna, For these the Brahmans ask: from. these is he who giveth not estranged,

verses.sa:
यावदस्या गोपतिर्नोपशृणुयादृचः स्वयम्।
चरेदस्य तावद् गोषु नास्य श्रुत्वा गृहे वसेत्॥
verses.tr: yāvadasyā gopatirnopaśṛṇuyādṛcaḥ svayam caredasya tāvad goṣu nāsya śrutvā gṛhe vaset
verses.en: Long as her owner hath not heard, himself, the verses, let her move Among his kine: when he hath heard, let her not make her home with him;

verses.sa:
यो अस्या ऋच उपश्रुत्याथ गोष्वचीचरत्।
आयुश्च तस्य भूतिं च देवा वृश्चन्ति हीडिताः॥
verses.tr: yo asyā ṛca upaśrutyātha goṣvacīcarat āyuśca tasya bhūtiṃ ca devā vṛścanti hīḍitāḥ
verses.en: He who hath heard her verses and still makes her roam among his kine, The Gods in anger rend away his life and his pros parity. -

verses.sa:
वशा चरन्ती बहुधा देवानां निहितो निधिः ।
आविष्कृणुष्व रूपाणि यदा स्थाम जिघांसति॥
verses.tr: vaśā carantī bahudhā devānāṃ nihito nidhiḥ āviṣkṛṇuṣva rūpāṇi yadā sthāma jighāṃsati
verses.en: Roaming in many a place the Cow is the stored treasure of the Gods. Make manifest thy shape and form when she would seek her dwelling-place,

verses.sa:
आविरात्मानं कृणुते यदा स्थाम जिघांसति ।
अथो ह ब्रह्मभ्यो वशा याञ्च्याय कृणुते मनः॥
verses.tr: āvirātmānaṃ kṛṇute yadā sthāma jighāṃsati atho ha brahmabhyo vaśā yāñcyāya kṛṇute manaḥ
verses.en: Her shape and form she manifests when she would seek her dwelling-place; Then verily the Cow attends to Brahman priests and their request.

verses.sa:
मनसा सं कल्पयति तद् देवां अपि गच्छति ।
ततो ह ब्रह्माणो वशामुपप्रयन्ति याचितुम्॥
verses.tr: manasā saṃ kalpayati tad devāṃ api gacchati tato ha brahmāṇo vaśāmupaprayanti yācitum
verses.en: This thought he settles in his mind, This surely goeth to the Gods, Then verily the Brahman priests approach that they may beg the Cow.

verses.sa:
स्वधाकारेण पितृभ्यो यज्ञेन देवताभ्यः ।
दानेन राजन्योऽ वशाया मातुर्हेडं न गच्छति॥
verses.tr: svadhākāreṇa pitṛbhyo yajñena devatābhyaḥ dānena rājanyo' vaśāyā māturheḍaṃ na gacchati
verses.en: By Savadha to the Fathers, by sacrifice to the Deities, By giving them the Cow, the Prince doth not incur the mother's wrath.

verses.sa:
वशा माता राजन्यऽस्य तथा संभूतमग्रशः ।
तस्या आहुरनर्पणं यद् ब्रह्मभ्यः प्रदीयते॥
verses.tr: vaśā mātā rājanya'sya tathā saṃbhūtamagraśaḥ tasyā āhuranarpaṇaṃ yad brahmabhyaḥ pradīyate
verses.en: The Princes mother is the Cow: so was it ordered from of old. She, when bestowed upon the priests, cannot be given back, they say.

verses.sa:
यथाज्यं प्रगृहीतमालुम्पेत् स्रुचो अग्नये ।
एवा ह ब्रह्मभ्यो वशा मग्नय आ वृश्चतेऽददत्॥
verses.tr: yathājyaṃ pragṛhītamālumpet sruco agnaye evā ha brahmabhyo vaśā magnaya ā vṛścate'dadat
verses.en: As molten butter, held at length, drops down to Agni: from the scoop, So falls away from Agni he who gives no Cow to Brahman priests.

verses.sa:
पुरोडाशवत्सा सुदुघा लोकेऽस्मा उप तिष्ठति ।
सास्मै सर्वान् कामान् वशा प्रददुषे दुहे॥
verses.tr: puroḍāśavatsā sudughā loke'smā upa tiṣṭhati sāsmai sarvān kāmān vaśā pradaduṣe duhe
verses.en: Good milker, with rice-cake as calf, she in the world comes nigh to him, To him who gave her as a gift the Cow grants every hope and wish,

verses.sa:
सर्वान् कामान् यमराज्ये वशा प्रददुषे दुहे ।
अथाहुर्नारकं लोकं निरुन्धानस्य याचिताम्॥
verses.tr: sarvān kāmān yamarājye vaśā pradaduṣe duhe athāhurnārakaṃ lokaṃ nirundhānasya yācitām
verses.en: In Yama's realm the Cow fulfils each wish for him who gave her up; But hell, they say, is for the man who, when they beg, bestow her not.

verses.sa:
प्रवीयमाना चरति क्रुद्धा गोपतये वशा।
वेहतं मा मन्यमानो मृत्योः पाशेषु बध्यताम्॥
verses.tr: pravīyamānā carati kruddhā gopataye vaśā vehataṃ mā manyamāno mṛtyoḥ pāśeṣu badhyatām
verses.en: Enraged against her owner roams the Cow when she hath been impregned, He deemed me fruitless, is her thought; let him be bound in snares of Death!

verses.sa:
यो वेहतं मन्यमानोऽमा च पचते वशाम्।
अप्यस्य पुत्रान् पौत्रांश्च याचयते बृहस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: yo vehataṃ manyamāno'mā ca pacate vaśām apyasya putrān pautrāṃśca yācayate bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.en: Whoever looking on the Cow as fruitless, cooks her flesh at home, Brihaspati compels his sons and children of his sons to beg.

verses.sa:
महदेषाव तपति चरन्ती गोषु गौरपि ।
अथो ह गोपतये वशाददुषे विषं दुहे॥
verses.tr: mahadeṣāva tapati carantī goṣu gaurapi atho ha gopataye vaśādaduṣe viṣaṃ duhe
verses.en: Downward she sends a mightly heat, though amid kine a Cow she roams. Poison she yields for him who owns and hath not given her away.

verses.sa:
प्रियं पशूनां भवति यद् ब्रह्मभ्यः प्रदीयते ।
अथो वशायास्तत् प्रियं यद् देवत्रा हविः स्यात्॥
verses.tr: priyaṃ paśūnāṃ bhavati yad brahmabhyaḥ pradīyate atho vaśāyāstat priyaṃ yad devatrā haviḥ syāt
verses.en: The animal is happy when it is bestowed upon the priests: But happy is the Cow when she is made a sacrifice to Gods.

verses.sa:
या वशा उदकल्पयन् देवा यज्ञादुदेत्य ।
तासां विलिप्त्यं भीमामुदाकुरुत नारदः॥
verses.tr: yā vaśā udakalpayan devā yajñādudetya tāsāṃ viliptyaṃ bhīmāmudākuruta nāradaḥ
verses.en: Narada chose the terrible Vilipti out of all the cows Which the Gods formed and framed when they had risen up from sacrifice

verses.sa:
तां देवा अमीमांसन्त वशेया३मवशेति ।
तामब्रवीन्नारद एषा वशानां वशतमेति॥
verses.tr: tāṃ devā amīmāṃsanta vaśeyā3mavaśeti tāmabravīnnārada eṣā vaśānāṃ vaśatameti
verses.en: The Gods considered her in doubt whether she were a Cow or not. Narada spake of her and said, The veriest Cow of cows is she.

verses.sa:
कति नु वशा नारद यास्त्वं वेत्थ मनुष्यजाः ।
तास्त्वा पृच्छामि विद्वांसं कस्या नाश्नीयादब्राह्मणः॥
verses.tr: kati nu vaśā nārada yāstvaṃ vettha manuṣyajāḥ tāstvā pṛcchāmi vidvāṃsaṃ kasyā nāśnīyādabrāhmaṇaḥ
verses.en: How many cows, O Narada, knowest thou, born among mankind? I ask thee who dost know, of which must none who is no Brahman eat?

verses.sa:
विलिप्त्या बृहस्पते या च सूतवशा वशा।
तस्या नाश्नीयादब्राह्मणो या आशंसेत भूत्याम्॥
verses.tr: viliptyā bṛhaspate yā ca sūtavaśā vaśā tasyā nāśnīyādabrāhmaṇo yā āśaṃseta bhūtyām
verses.en: Vilipti, cow, and she who drops no second calf, Brihaspati! Of these none not a Brahmana, should eat if he hope for eminence.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अस्तु नारदानुष्ठु विदुषे वशा।
कतमासां भीमतमा यामदत्त्वा पराभवेत्॥
verses.tr: namaste astu nāradānuṣṭhu viduṣe vaśā katamāsāṃ bhīmatamā yāmadattvā parābhavet
verses.en: Homage, O Narada, to thee who hast quick knowledge of the cows. Which of these is the direst, whose withholding bringeth death to man?

verses.sa:
विलिप्ती या बृहस्पतेऽथो सूतवशा वशा।
तस्या नाश्नीयादब्राह्मणो य आशंसेत भूत्याम्॥
verses.tr: viliptī yā bṛhaspate'tho sūtavaśā vaśā tasyā nāśnīyādabrāhmaṇo ya āśaṃseta bhūtyām
verses.en: Vilipti, O Brihaspati, cow, mother of no second calf—Of these none not a Brahman should eat if he hope for eminence.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि वै वशाजातानि विलिप्ती सूतवशा वशा।
ताः प्र यच्छेद् ब्रह्मभ्यः सोऽनाव्रस्कः प्रजापतौ॥
verses.tr: trīṇi vai vaśājātāni viliptī sūtavaśā vaśā tāḥ pra yacched brahmabhyaḥ so'nāvraskaḥ prajāpatau
verses.en: Threefold are kine, Vilipti, cow, the mother of no second calf: These one should give to priests, and he will not offend Prajapati.

verses.sa:
एतद् वो ब्राह्मणा हविरिति मन्वीत याचितः ।
वशां चेदेनं याचेयुर्या भीमाददुषो गृहे॥
verses.tr: etad vo brāhmaṇā haviriti manvīta yācitaḥ vaśāṃ cedenaṃ yāceyuryā bhīmādaduṣo gṛhe
verses.en: This, Brahmans! is your sacrifice: thus should one think when he is asked, What time they beg from him the Cow fearful in the 'withholdeth's house,

verses.sa:
देवा वशां पर्यवदन् न नोऽदादिति हीडिताः ।
एताभिरृग्भिर्भेदं तस्माद् वै स पराभवत्॥
verses.tr: devā vaśāṃ paryavadan na no'dāditi hīḍitāḥ etābhirṛgbhirbhedaṃ tasmād vai sa parābhavat
verses.en: He gave her not to us, so spake the Gods, in anger, of the Cow. With these same verses they addressed Bheda: this brought him to his death,

verses.sa:
उतैनां भेदो नाददाद् वशामिन्द्रेण याचितः ।
तस्मात् तं देवा आगसोऽवृश्चन्नहमुत्तरे॥
verses.tr: utaināṃ bhedo nādadād vaśāmindreṇa yācitaḥ tasmāt taṃ devā āgaso'vṛścannahamuttare
verses.en: Solicited by Indra, still Bheda refused to give this Cow. In strife for victory the Gods destroyed him for that sin of his,

verses.sa:
ये वशाया अदानाय वदन्ति परिरापिणः ।
इन्द्रस्य मन्यवे जाल्मा आ वृश्चन्ते अचित्त्या॥
verses.tr: ye vaśāyā adānāya vadanti parirāpiṇaḥ indrasya manyave jālmā ā vṛścante acittyā
verses.en: The men of evil counsel who ad vise refusal of the Cow, Miscreants, through their foolishness, are subjected to Indra's wrath.

verses.sa:
ये गोपतिं पराणीयाथाहुर्मा ददा इति ।
रुद्रस्यास्तां ते हेतिं परि यन्त्यचित्त्या॥
verses.tr: ye gopatiṃ parāṇīyāthāhurmā dadā iti rudrasyāstāṃ te hetiṃ pari yantyacittyā
verses.en: They who seduce the owner of the Cow and say, Bestow her not, Encounter through their want of sense the missile shot by Rudra's hand.

verses.sa:
यदि हुतं यद्यहुताममा च पचते वशाम्।
देवान्त्सब्राह्मणानृत्वा जिह्मो लोकान्निरृच्छति॥
verses.tr: yadi hutaṃ yadyahutāmamā ca pacate vaśām devāntsabrāhmaṇānṛtvā jihmo lokānnirṛcchati
verses.en: If in his home one cooks the Cow, sacrificed or not sacrificed. Wronged of Gods and Brahmans, he departs, dishonest, from the world.

sections.label: On the duty of giving cows to Brahmans
sections.name: Book 12, hymn 5

verses.sa: श्रमेण तपसा सृष्टा ब्रह्मणा वित्तर्ते श्रिता॥
verses.tr: śrameṇa tapasā sṛṣṭā brahmaṇā vittarte śritā
verses.en: Created by toil and holy fervour, found by devotion, resting in right;

verses.sa: सत्येनावृता श्रिया प्रावृता यशसा परीवृता॥
verses.tr: satyenāvṛtā śriyā prāvṛtā yaśasā parīvṛtā
verses.en: Invested with truth, surrounded with honour, compassed about with glory;

verses.sa: स्वधया परिहिता श्रद्धया पर्यूढा दीक्षया गुप्ता यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठिता लोको निधनम्॥
verses.tr: svadhayā parihitā śraddhayā paryūḍhā dīkṣayā guptā yajñe pratiṣṭhitā loko nidhanam
verses.en: Girt round with inherent power, fortified with faith, protected, by consecration, installed at sacrifice, the world her resting-place;

verses.sa: ब्रह्म पदवायं ब्राह्मणोऽधिपतिः॥
verses.tr: brahma padavāyaṃ brāhmaṇo'dhipatiḥ
verses.en: Brahma her guide, the Brahman her lord and ruler;

verses.sa: तामाददानस्य ब्रह्मगवीं जिनतो ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियस्य॥
verses.tr: tāmādadānasya brahmagavīṃ jinato brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyasya
verses.en: Of the Kshatriya who taketh to himself this Brahman's cow and oppresseth the Brahman

verses.sa: अप क्रामति सूनृता वीर्यं१ पुण्या लक्ष्मीः॥
verses.tr: apa krāmati sūnṛtā vīryaṃ1 puṇyā lakṣmīḥ
verses.en: The glory, the heroism, and the favouring fortune depart,

verses.sa:
(2)
(७-११) ७-९ आर्च्यनुष्टुप् (७ भुरिक्), १० उष्णिक्, (७-१७ एकपदा), ११ आर्ची निचृत्पङ्क्तिः।
ओजश्च तेजश्च सहश्च बलं च वाक् चेन्द्रियं च श्रीश्च धर्मश्च॥
verses.tr: (2) (7-11) 7-9 ārcyanuṣṭup (7 bhurik), 10 uṣṇik, (7-17 ekapadā), 11 ārcī nicṛtpaṅktiḥ ojaśca tejaśca sahaśca balaṃ ca vāk cendriyaṃ ca śrīśca dharmaśca
verses.en: The energy and vigour, the power and might the speech and mental strength, the glory and duty;

verses.sa: ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं च राष्ट्रं च विशश्च त्विषिश्च यशश्च वर्चश्च द्रविणं च॥
verses.tr: brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca viśaśca tviṣiśca yaśaśca varcaśca draviṇaṃ ca
verses.en: Devotion and princely sway, kingship and people, brilliance and honour, and splendour and wealth;

verses.sa: आयुश्च रूपं च नाम च कीर्तिश्च प्राणश्चापानश्च चक्षुश्च श्रोत्रं च॥
verses.tr: āyuśca rūpaṃ ca nāma ca kīrtiśca prāṇaścāpānaśca cakṣuśca śrotraṃ ca
verses.en: Long life and goodly form, and name and fame, in-breathing and expiration, and sight, and hearing;

verses.sa: पयश्च रसश्चान्नं चान्नाद्यं चर्तं च सत्यं चेष्टं च पूर्तं च प्रजा च पशवश्च॥
verses.tr: payaśca rasaścānnaṃ cānnādyaṃ cartaṃ ca satyaṃ ceṣṭaṃ ca pūrtaṃ ca prajā ca paśavaśca
verses.en: Milk and flavour, and food and nourishment, and right and truth, and action and fulfilment, and children and cattle;

verses.sa: तानि सर्वाण्यप क्रामन्ति ब्रह्मगवीमाददानस्य जिनतो ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियस्य॥
verses.tr: tāni sarvāṇyapa krāmanti brahmagavīmādadānasya jinato brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyasya
verses.en: All these blessings of a Kshatriya depart from him when he oppresseth the Brahman and taketh to himself the Brahman's cow.

verses.sa:
(3)
(१२-२७) १२ विराड् विषमा गायत्री, १३ आसुर्यनुष्टुप्, १४, २५ साम्नी उष्णिक्, १५ गायत्री, १६-१७,
१९-२० प्राजापत्याऽनुष्टुप्, १८ याजुषी जगती, २१,२५ साम्न्यनुष्टुप्, २२ साम्नी बृहती, २३ याजुषी त्रिष्टुप्,
२४ आसुरी गायत्री, २७ आर्च्युष्णिक्।
सैषा भीमा ब्रह्मगव्य१घविषा साक्षात् कृत्या कूल्बजमावृता॥
verses.tr: (3) (12-27) 12 virāḍ viṣamā gāyatrī, 13 āsuryanuṣṭup, 14, 25 sāmnī uṣṇik, 15 gāyatrī, 16-17, 19-20 prājāpatyā'nuṣṭup, 18 yājuṣī jagatī, 21,25 sāmnyanuṣṭup, 22 sāmnī bṛhatī, 23 yājuṣī triṣṭup, 24 āsurī gāyatrī, 27 ārcyuṣṇik saiṣā bhīmā brahmagavya1ghaviṣā sākṣāt kṛtyā kūlbajamāvṛtā
verses.en: Terrible is she, this Brahman's cow, and fearfully venomous; visibly witchcraft.

verses.sa: सर्वाण्यस्यां घोराणि सर्वे च मृत्यवः॥
verses.tr: sarvāṇyasyāṃ ghorāṇi sarve ca mṛtyavaḥ
verses.en: In her are all horrors and all deaths.

verses.sa: सर्वाण्यस्यां क्रूराणि सर्वे पुरुषवधाः॥
verses.tr: sarvāṇyasyāṃ krūrāṇi sarve puruṣavadhāḥ
verses.en: In her are all dreadfn! deeds, all slaughters of mankind.

verses.sa: सा ब्रह्मज्यं देवपीयुं ब्रह्मगव्याऽदीयमाना मृत्योः पद्वीश आ द्यति॥
verses.tr: sā brahmajyaṃ devapīyuṃ brahmagavyā'dīyamānā mṛtyoḥ padvīśa ā dyati
verses.en: This, the Brahman's cow, being appropriated, holdeth bound in the fetter of Death the oppressor of the Brahman, the blasphemer of the Gods,

verses.sa: मेनिः शतवधा हि सा ब्रह्मज्यस्य क्षितिर्हि सा॥
verses.tr: meniḥ śatavadhā hi sā brahmajyasya kṣitirhi sā
verses.en: A hundred-killing bolt is she: she slays the Brahman's injurer,

verses.sa: तस्माद् वै ब्राह्मणानां गौर्दुराधर्षा विजानता॥
verses.tr: tasmād vai brāhmaṇānāṃ gaurdurādharṣā vijānatā
verses.en: Therefore the Brahmans' cow is held inviolable by the wise,

verses.sa: वज्रो धावन्ती वैश्वानर उद्वीता॥
verses.tr: vajro dhāvantī vaiśvānara udvītā
verses.en: Running she is a thunderbolt, when driven away she is Vaisvanara;

verses.sa: हेतिः शफानुत्खिदन्ती महादेवो३ऽपेक्षमाणा॥
verses.tr: hetiḥ śaphānutkhidantī mahādevo3'pekṣamāṇā
verses.en: An arrow when she draweth up her hooves, and Mahadeva when she looketh around;

verses.sa: क्षुरपविरीक्षमाणा वाश्यमानाभि स्फूर्जति॥
verses.tr: kṣurapavirīkṣamāṇā vāśyamānābhi sphūrjati
verses.en: Sharp as a razor when she beholdeth, she thundereth when she belloweth.

verses.sa: मृत्युर्हिङ्कृण्वत्यु१ग्रो देवः पुच्छं पर्यस्यन्ती॥
verses.tr: mṛtyurhiṅkṛṇvatyu1gro devaḥ pucchaṃ paryasyantī
verses.en: Death is she when she loweth, and a fierce God when she wisheth her tail;

verses.sa: सर्वज्यानिः कर्णौ वरीवर्जयन्ती राजयक्ष्मो मेहन्ती॥
verses.tr: sarvajyāniḥ karṇau varīvarjayantī rājayakṣmo mehantī
verses.en: Utter destruction when she moveth her ears this way and that, Consumption when she droppeth water;

verses.sa: मेनिर्दुह्यमाना शीर्षक्तिर्दुग्धा॥
verses.tr: menirduhyamānā śīrṣaktirdugdhā
verses.en: A missile when milking, pain in the head when milked;

verses.sa: सेदिरुपतिष्ठन्ती मिथोयोधः परामृष्टा॥
verses.tr: sedirupatiṣṭhantī mithoyodhaḥ parāmṛṣṭā
verses.en: The taking away of strength when she approacheth, a hand-to-hand fighter when roughly touched;

verses.sa: शरव्या३ मुखेऽपिनह्यमान ऋतिर्हन्यमाना॥
verses.tr: śaravyā3 mukhe'pinahyamāna ṛtirhanyamānā
verses.en: Wounding like an arrow when she is fastened by her mouth, contention when she is beaten;

verses.sa: अघविषा निपतन्ती तमो निपतिता॥
verses.tr: aghaviṣā nipatantī tamo nipatitā
verses.en: Fearfully venomous when falling, darkness when she hath fallen down.

verses.sa: अनुगच्छन्ती प्राणानुप दासयति ब्रह्मगवी ब्रह्मज्यस्य॥
verses.tr: anugacchantī prāṇānupa dāsayati brahmagavī brahmajyasya
verses.en: Following him, the Brahman's cow extinguisheth the vital breath of the injurer of the Brahman;

verses.sa:
(4)
(२८-३८) आसुरी गायत्री, २९, ३७ आसुर्यनुष्टुप्, ३० साम्न्यनुष्टुप्, ३१ याजषी त्रिष्टुप्, ३२ साम्नी गायत्री,
३३-३४ साम्नी बृहती, ३५ भुरिक्साम्न्यनुष्टुप्, ३६ साम्न्युष्णिक्, ३८ प्रतिष्ठा गायत्री।
वैरं विकृत्यमाना पौत्राद्यं विभाज्यमाना॥
verses.tr: (4) (28-38) āsurī gāyatrī, 29, 37 āsuryanuṣṭup, 30 sāmnyanuṣṭup, 31 yājaṣī triṣṭup, 32 sāmnī gāyatrī, 33-34 sāmnī bṛhatī, 35 bhuriksāmnyanuṣṭup, 36 sāmnyuṣṇik, 38 pratiṣṭhā gāyatrī vairaṃ vikṛtyamānā pautrādyaṃ vibhājyamānā
verses.en: Hostility when being cut to pieces, woe to children when the portions are distributed;

verses.sa: देवहेतिर्ह्रियमाणा व्यृद्धिर्हृता॥
verses.tr: devahetirhriyamāṇā vyṛddhirhṛtā
verses.en: A destructive missile of Gods when she is being seized, misfortune when carried away;

verses.sa: पाप्माधिधीयमाना पारुष्यमवधीयमाना॥
verses.tr: pāpmādhidhīyamānā pāruṣyamavadhīyamānā
verses.en: Misery while being additionally acquired, contumely and abuse while being put in the stall;

verses.sa: विषं प्रयस्यन्ती तक्मा प्रयस्ता॥
verses.tr: viṣaṃ prayasyantī takmā prayastā
verses.en: Poison when in agitation, fever when seasoned with condiments;

verses.sa: अघं पच्यमाना दुष्वप्न्यं पक्वा॥
verses.tr: aghaṃ pacyamānā duṣvapnyaṃ pakvā
verses.en: Sin while she is cooking, evil dream when she is cooked;

verses.sa: मूलबर्हणी पर्याक्रियमाणा क्षितिः पर्याकृता॥
verses.tr: mūlabarhaṇī paryākriyamāṇā kṣitiḥ paryākṛtā
verses.en: Uprooting when she is being turned round, destruction when she hath been turned round;

verses.sa: असंज्ञा गन्धेन शुगुद्ध्रियमाणाशीविष उद्धृता॥
verses.tr: asaṃjñā gandhena śuguddhriyamāṇāśīviṣa uddhṛtā
verses.en: Discord by her smell, grief when she is being eviscerated; a serpent with poison in its fang when drawn;

verses.sa: अभूतिरुपह्रियमाणा पराभूतिरुपहृता॥
verses.tr: abhūtirupahriyamāṇā parābhūtirupahṛtā
verses.en: Loss of power while sacrifigially presented, humiliation when she hath been offered;

verses.sa: शर्व क्रुद्धः पिश्यमाना शिमिदा पिशिता॥
verses.tr: śarva kruddhaḥ piśyamānā śimidā piśitā
verses.en: Wrathful Sarva. while being carved, Simida when cut up;

verses.sa: अवर्तिरश्यमाना निरृतिरशिता॥
verses.tr: avartiraśyamānā nirṛtiraśitā
verses.en: Poverty while she is being eaten, Destruction when eaten.

verses.sa: अशिता लोकाच्छिनत्ति ब्रह्मगवी ब्रह्मज्यमस्माच्चामुष्माच्च॥
verses.tr: aśitā lokācchinatti brahmagavī brahmajyamasmāccāmuṣmācca
verses.en: The Brahman's cow when eaten cuts off the injurer of Brahmans both from this world and from the world 'yonder,

verses.sa:
(5)
(३९-४६) ३९ साम्नी पङ्क्तिः, ४० याजुष्यनुष्टुप्, ४१, ४६ भुरिक् साम्न्यनुष्टुप्, ४२ आसुरी बृहती,
४३ साम्नी बृहती, ४४ पिपीलिकमध्याऽनुष्टुप्, ४५ आर्ची बृहती।
तस्या आहननं कृत्या मेनिराशसनं वलग ऊबध्यम्॥
verses.tr: (5) (39-46) 39 sāmnī paṅktiḥ, 40 yājuṣyanuṣṭup, 41, 46 bhurik sāmnyanuṣṭup, 42 āsurī bṛhatī, 43 sāmnī bṛhatī, 44 pipīlikamadhyā'nuṣṭup, 45 ārcī bṛhatī tasyā āhananaṃ kṛtyā menirāśasanaṃ valaga ūbadhyam
verses.en: Her slaughter is the sin of witchcraft; her cutting-up is a thunderbolt, hgr undigested grass is a secret spell.

verses.sa: अस्वगता परिह्णुता॥
verses.tr: asvagatā parihṇutā
verses.en: Homelessness is she when denied her rights.

verses.sa: अग्निः क्रव्याद् भूत्वा ब्रह्मगवी ब्रह्मज्यं प्रविश्यात्ति॥
verses.tr: agniḥ kravyād bhūtvā brahmagavī brahmajyaṃ praviśyātti
verses.en: Having become Flesh-eating Agni the Brahman's cow entereth into and devoureth the oppressor of Brahmans.

verses.sa: सर्वास्याङ्गा पर्वा मूलानि वृश्चति॥
verses.tr: sarvāsyāṅgā parvā mūlāni vṛścati
verses.en: She sunders all his members, joints, and roots,

verses.sa: छिनत्त्यस्य पितृबन्धु परा भावयति मातृबन्धु॥
verses.tr: chinattyasya pitṛbandhu parā bhāvayati mātṛbandhu
verses.en: She cuts off relationship on the father's side and destroys maternal kinship.

verses.sa: विवाहां ज्ञातीन्त्सर्वानपि क्षापयति ब्रह्मगवी ब्रह्मज्यस्य क्षत्रियेणापुनर्दीयमाना॥
verses.tr: vivāhāṃ jñātīntsarvānapi kṣāpayati brahmagavī brahmajyasya kṣatriyeṇāpunardīyamānā
verses.en: The Brahman's cow, not restored by a Kshatriya, ruins the marriages and all the kinsmen of the Brahman's oppressor.

verses.sa: अवास्तुमेनमस्वगमप्रजसं करोत्यपरापरणो भवति क्षीयते॥
verses.tr: avāstumenamasvagamaprajasaṃ karotyaparāparaṇo bhavati kṣīyate
verses.en: She makes him houseless, homeless, childless: he is extinguished without posterity to succeed him.

verses.sa: य एवं विदुषो ब्राह्मणस्य क्षत्रियो गामादत्ते॥
verses.tr: ya evaṃ viduṣo brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyo gāmādatte
verses.en: So shall it be with the Kshatriya who takes to himself the cow of the Brahman who hath this knowledge.

verses.tr: (6) (47-61) 47, 49, 51-53, 57-59, 61 prājāpatyā'nuṣṭup, 48 ārcyanuṣṭup, 50 sāmnī bṛhatī, 54-55 prājāpatyoṣṇik, 56 āsurī gāyatrī, 60 gāyatrī kṣipraṃ vai tasyāhanane gṛdhrāḥ kurvata ailabam
verses.en: Quickly, when he is smitten down by death, the clamorous vultures cry:

verses.sa: क्षिप्रं वै तस्यादहनं परि नृत्यन्ति केशनीराघ्नानाः पाणिनोरसि कुर्वाणाः पापमैलबम्॥
verses.tr: kṣipraṃ vai tasyādahanaṃ pari nṛtyanti keśanīrāghnānāḥ pāṇinorasi kurvāṇāḥ pāpamailabam
verses.en: Quickly around his funeral fire dance women with dishevelled locks, Striking the hand upon the breast and uttering their evil shriek,

verses.sa: क्षिप्रं वै तस्य वास्तुषु वृकाः कुर्वत ऐलबम्॥
verses.tr: kṣipraṃ vai tasya vāstuṣu vṛkāḥ kurvata ailabam
verses.en: Quickly the wolves are howling in the habitation where he lived:

verses.sa: क्षिप्रं वै तस्य पृच्छन्ति यत् तदासी३दिदं नु ता३दिति॥
verses.tr: kṣipraṃ vai tasya pṛcchanti yat tadāsī3didaṃ nu tā3diti
verses.en: Quickly they ask about him, What is this? What thing hath happened here?

verses.sa: छिन्ध्या च्छिन्धि प्र छिन्ध्यपि क्षापय क्षापय॥
verses.tr: chindhyā cchindhi pra chindhyapi kṣāpaya kṣāpaya
verses.en: Bend, rend to pieces, rend away, destroy, destroy him utterly.

verses.sa: आददानमाङ्गिरसि ब्रह्मज्यमुप दासय॥
verses.tr: ādadānamāṅgirasi brahmajyamupa dāsaya
verses.en: Destroy A ngirasi! the wretch who robs and wrongs the Brahmans, born

verses.sa: वैश्वदेवी ह्यु१च्यसे कृत्या कूल्बजमावृता॥
verses.tr: vaiśvadevī hyu1cyase kṛtyā kūlbajamāvṛtā
verses.en: Of evil womb, thou witchcraft hid, for Vaisvadevt is thy name,

verses.sa: ओषन्ती समोषन्ती ब्रह्मणो वज्रः॥
verses.tr: oṣantī samoṣantī brahmaṇo vajraḥ
verses.en: Consuming, burning all things up, the thunderbolt of spell and charm.

verses.sa: क्षुरपविर्मृत्युर्भूत्वा वि धाव त्वम्॥
verses.tr: kṣurapavirmṛtyurbhūtvā vi dhāva tvam
verses.en: Go thou, becoming Mrityu sharp as razor's edge, pursue thy course:

verses.sa: आ दत्से जिनतां वर्च इष्टं पूर्तं चाशिषः॥
verses.tr: ā datse jinatāṃ varca iṣṭaṃ pūrtaṃ cāśiṣaḥ
verses.en: Thou bearest off the tyrants' strength, their store of merit, and their prayers,

verses.sa: आदाय जीतं जीताय लोके३ऽमुष्मिन् प्र यच्छसि॥
verses.tr: ādāya jītaṃ jītāya loke3'muṣmin pra yacchasi
verses.en: Bearing off wrong, thou givest in that world to him who hath been wronged.

verses.sa: अघ्न्ये पदवीर्भव ब्राह्मणस्याभिशस्त्या॥
verses.tr: aghnye padavīrbhava brāhmaṇasyābhiśastyā
verses.en: O Cow, become a tracker through the curse the Brahman hath pronounced,

verses.sa: मेनिः शरव्याऽ भवाघादघविषा भव॥
verses.tr: meniḥ śaravyā' bhavāghādaghaviṣā bhava
verses.en: Become a bolt, an arrow through his sin, be terribly venomous,

verses.sa: अघ्न्ये प्र शिरो जहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य कृतागसो देवपीयोरराधसः॥
verses.tr: aghnye pra śiro jahi brahmajyasya kṛtāgaso devapīyorarādhasaḥ
verses.en: O Cow, break thou the head of him who wrongs the Brahmans, criminal, niggard, blasphemer of the Gods.

verses.sa: त्वया प्रमूर्णं मृदितमग्निर्दहतु दुश्चितम्॥
verses.tr: tvayā pramūrṇaṃ mṛditamagnirdahatu duścitam
verses.en: Let Agni burn the spiteful wretch when crushed to death and slain by thee,

verses.sa:
(7)
(६२-७३) ६२-६४, ६६,६८-७० प्राजापत्याऽनुष्टुप्, ६५ गायत्री, ६७ प्राजापत्या गायत्री, ७१ आसुरी पङ्क्तिः,
७२ प्राजापत्या त्रिष्टुप् ७३ आसुर्युष्णिक्।
वृश्च प्र वृश्च सं वृश्च दह प्र दह सं दह॥
verses.tr: (7) (62-73) 62-64, 66,68-70 prājāpatyā'nuṣṭup, 65 gāyatrī, 67 prājāpatyā gāyatrī, 71 āsurī paṅktiḥ, 72 prājāpatyā triṣṭup 73 āsuryuṣṇik vṛśca pra vṛśca saṃ vṛśca daha pra daha saṃ daha
verses.en: Rend, rend to bits, rend through and through, scorch and consume and burn to dust,

verses.sa: ब्रह्मज्यं देव्यघ्न्य आ मूलादनुसंदह॥
verses.tr: brahmajyaṃ devyaghnya ā mūlādanusaṃdaha
verses.en: Consume thou, even from the root, the Brahmans' tyrant, godlike Cow!

verses.sa: यथायाद् यमसादनात् पापलोकान् परावतः॥
verses.tr: yathāyād yamasādanāt pāpalokān parāvataḥ
verses.en: That he may go from Yama's home afar into the. worlds of sin.

verses.sa: एवा त्वं देव्यघ्न्ये ब्रह्मज्यस्य कृतागसो देवपीयोरराधसः॥
verses.tr: evā tvaṃ devyaghnye brahmajyasya kṛtāgaso devapīyorarādhasaḥ
verses.en: So, Goddess Cow, do thou from him, the Brahmans' tyrant, criminal, niggard, blasphemer of the Gods,

verses.sa: वज्रेण शतपर्वणा तीक्ष्णेन क्षुरभृष्टिना॥
verses.tr: vajreṇa śataparvaṇā tīkṣṇena kṣurabhṛṣṭinā
verses.en: With hundred-knotted thunderbolt, sharpened and edged with razor-blades,

verses.sa: प्र स्कन्धान् प्र शिरो जहि॥
verses.tr: pra skandhān pra śiro jahi
verses.en: Strike off the shoulders and the head.

verses.sa: लोमान्यस्य सं छिन्धि त्वचमस्य वि वेष्टय॥
verses.tr: lomānyasya saṃ chindhi tvacamasya vi veṣṭaya
verses.en: Snatch tbou the hair from off his head, and from his body strip the skin:

verses.sa: मांसान्यस्य शातय स्नावान्यस्य सं वृह॥
verses.tr: māṃsānyasya śātaya snāvānyasya saṃ vṛha
verses.en: Tear out his sinews, cause his flesh to fall in pieces from his frame "

verses.sa: अस्थीन्यस्य पीडय मज्जानमस्य निर्जहि॥
verses.tr: asthīnyasya pīḍaya majjānamasya nirjahi
verses.en: Crush thou his bones together, strike and beat the marrow out of him.

verses.sa: सर्वास्याङ्गा पर्वाणि वि श्रथय॥
verses.tr: sarvāsyāṅgā parvāṇi vi śrathaya
verses.en: Dislocate all his limbs and joints,

verses.sa: अग्निरेनं क्रव्यात् पृथिव्या नुदतामुदोषतु वायुरन्तरिक्षान्महतो वरिम्णः॥
verses.tr: agnirenaṃ kravyāt pṛthivyā nudatāmudoṣatu vāyurantarikṣānmahato varimṇaḥ
verses.en: From earth let the Carnivorous Agni drive him, let Vayu burn him from mid-air's broad region,

verses.sa: सूर्य एनं दिवः प्र णुदतां न्योऽषतु॥
verses.tr: sūrya enaṃ divaḥ pra ṇudatāṃ nyo'ṣatu
verses.en: From heaven let Surya drive him and consume him,
